/-- Origin protection on entry for parameter `p` in state `s'` (§72.3): if `p` is a `Modify`
authority with direct origin `o`, `o` is exercisable in no mode. -/
def ParamOriginHidden (s' : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s'.A[p]?) (fun y => y.mode = .modify →
    OptP y.origin (fun o => ¬ s'.ExercisableAt o .observe ∧ ¬ s'.ExercisableAt o .modify) True) True

/-- Decidability of `ParamOriginHidden` (§72.3). -/
instance (s' : S3) (p : Nat) : Decidable (ParamOriginHidden s' p) := by
  unfold ParamOriginHidden; infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `enterFrame` (§72). The modes/footprints/parameter-passing part of §72.2 is
not represented. -/
structure EnterPre (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : Prop where
  /-- §72.1: the calling frame, the current frame, is live. -/
  callerLive : s.F ≠ []
  /-- §72.1: each parameter is an active derived authority held by the caller. -/
  params : ∀ a ∈ ps, OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.holder = .frame s.top ∧
    y.origin ≠ none) False
  /-- §72.2: the locals form a well-formed shape (each parent is an earlier local). -/
  localsOK : ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape
  /-- §72.3: origin protection on entry, in the resulting state. -/
  originHidden : ∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden (enterEff s ps ls) p
  /-- §72.4: `AnchorOrderHeld` over the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeld (enterEff s ps ls)

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `enterFrame` (§72). -/
instance (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : Decidable (EnterPre s ps ls) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.F ≠ [] ∧ (∀ a ∈ ps, OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧
      y.holder = .frame s.top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False) ∧ ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape ∧
    (∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden (enterEff s ps ls) p) ∧ AnchorOrderHeld (enterEff s ps ls))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩

/-- `enterFrame` as a relation (§72). -/
def EnterStep (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (EnterPre s ps ls) (enterEff s ps ls)

/-! ## O7 `exitFrame` (§73) -/

/-- Authority `x` survives the exit to stack `F₀` (§73.4): active and held by a surviving frame
or by a usable place whose terminal owner survives. -/
def Survives (s : S3) (F₀ : Frames) (x : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ HolderLive { s with F := F₀ } y.holder) False

/-- Decidability of `Survives` (§73.4). -/
instance (s : S3) (F₀ : Frames) (x : Nat) : Decidable (Survives s F₀ x) := by
  unfold Survives; infer_instance

/-- First surviving authority of a list (§73.4). -/
def firstSurv (s : S3) (F₀ : Frames) (l : List Nat) : Option Nat :=
  l.find? fun z => decide (Survives s F₀ z)

/-- Authority `a` after the exit (§73, `ok` effect): released unless it survives; a surviving
derived authority is reanchored to the first surviving active origin of its chain. -/
def exitG (s : S3) (F₀ : Frames) (a : Nat) (y : Authority) : Authority :=
  if Survives s F₀ a then
    match y.origin with
    | none => y
    | some _ => { y with origin := firstSurv s F₀ (s.ancs a) }
  else { y with active := false }

/-- Effect of `exitFrame` (§73, `ok` effect): the current frame is popped; authorities that do
not survive are released; surviving derived authorities and the anchors of `D` are reanchored to
the first surviving authority of their chains. -/
def exitEff (s : S3) : S3 :=
  { s with
    F := s.F.tail
    D := fun q => (s.D q).map fun x => (firstSurv s s.F.tail (x :: s.ancs x)).getD x
    A := mapI (exitG s s.F.tail) 0 s.A }

/-- Preconditions of `exitFrame` (§73). The result clause of §73.2 is not represented. -/
structure ExitPre (k : K) (s : S3) : Prop where
  /-- §73.1: the current frame is not the initial frame and has a surviving caller. -/
  hasCaller : s.F.tail ≠ []
  /-- §73.2, §73.4, §73.5: every anchor of a place usable after the exit has a surviving
  authority among itself and its origins. -/
  anchors : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, ({ s with F := s.F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
    ∀ x ∈ s.D q, firstSurv s s.F.tail (x :: s.ancs x) ≠ none
  /-- §73.4: every surviving derived authority has a surviving active origin. -/
  origins : ∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, Survives s s.F.tail a → s.org a ≠ none →
    firstSurv s s.F.tail (s.ancs a) ≠ none
  /-- §73.3: no leaf of a place that dies with the frame is pinned, statically or
  dynamically. -/
  notPinned : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q →
    ¬ ({ s with F := s.F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
    ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, s.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l
  /-- §73.5: `AnchorOrderHeld` in the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeld (exitEff s)

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `exitFrame` (§73). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : S3) : Decidable (ExitPre k s) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.F.tail ≠ [] ∧
    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, ({ s with F := s.F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
      ∀ x ∈ s.D q, firstSurv s s.F.tail (x :: s.ancs x) ≠ none) ∧
    (∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, Survives s s.F.tail a → s.org a ≠ none →
      firstSurv s s.F.tail (s.ancs a) ≠ none) ∧
    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → ¬ ({ s with F := s.F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
      ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, s.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l) ∧
    AnchorOrderHeld (exitEff s))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩

/-- `exitFrame` as a relation (§73). -/
def ExitStep (k : K) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop := Guarded (ExitPre k s) (exitEff s)

/-! ## O9 `read`, O10 `write`, O11 `writeShared` (§66–§68) -/

/-- Leaf `l` belongs to a usable place (§66.1, §67.1, §68.1). -/
def LeafOfUsable (s : S3) (l : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q ∧ l ∈ footprint s.P q

/-- Decidability of `LeafOfUsable` (§66.1). -/
instance (s : S3) (l : Nat) : Decidable (LeafOfUsable s l) := by
  unfold LeafOfUsable; infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `read` of the leaves `ls` through `access` (§66). The type and storage
contract of §66.3 is not represented. -/
structure Read3Pre (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §66.1: every leaf read belongs to a usable place. -/
  usable : ∀ l ∈ ls, LeafOfUsable s l
  /-- §66.1: every leaf read is `Init`. -/
  init : ∀ l ∈ ls, s.I l = .init
  /-- §66.2: `access` is exercisable in `Observe`. -/
  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt a .observe
  /-- §66.2: the effective mode of `access` permits observation of each leaf. -/
  effectivePresent : ∀ l ∈ ls, effective s a l ≠ none
  /-- §66.3: required anchors are valid. -/
  anchorsValid : ∀ l ∈ ls, DepsValid s l

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `read` (§66). -/
instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) : Decidable (Read3Pre s a ls) :=
  decidable_of_iff ((∀ l ∈ ls, LeafOfUsable s l) ∧ (∀ l ∈ ls, s.I l = .init) ∧
    s.ExercisableAt a .observe ∧ (∀ l ∈ ls, effective s a l ≠ none) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ ls, DepsValid s l))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩

/-- `read` as a relation (§66): the state is unchanged. -/
def Read3Step (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (Read3Pre s a ls) s

/-- Preconditions of an ordinary `write` of the leaves `ls` through `access` (§67). The type,
storage and abstraction constraints of §67.3 are not represented. -/
structure Write3Pre (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §67.1: targeted leaves belong to usable places. -/
  usable : ∀ l ∈ ls, LeafOfUsable s l
  /-- §67.1: `access` is exercisable in `Modify`. -/
  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt a .modify
  /-- §67.1: `access` has effective `Modify` over each leaf. -/
  effectiveModify : ∀ l ∈ ls, effective s a l = some .modify
  /-- §67.2: no other authority holds an effective mode, all incompatible with `Modify` (§50),
  over the written leaves. -/
  exclusive : ∀ l ∈ ls, ∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, b ≠ a → effective s b l = none
  /-- §67.3: anchors remain valid. -/
  anchorsValid : ∀ l ∈ ls, DepsValid s l

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `write` (§67). -/
instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) : Decidable (Write3Pre s a ls) :=
  decidable_of_iff ((∀ l ∈ ls, LeafOfUsable s l) ∧ s.ExercisableAt a .modify ∧
    (∀ l ∈ ls, effective s a l = some .modify) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ ls, ∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, b ≠ a → effective s b l = none) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ ls, DepsValid s l))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩

/-- Effect of a write (§67, §68, `ok` effect): the written leaves become `Init`. -/
def write3Eff (s : S3) (ls : List Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with I := fun p => if p ∈ ls then .init else s.I p }

/-- `write` as a relation (§67). -/
def Write3Step (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (Write3Pre s a ls) (write3Eff s ls)

/-- Preconditions of `writeShared` of the leaves `ls` through `access` (§68). -/
structure WriteSharedPre (k : K) (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §68.1: every leaf of the region is usable (belongs to a usable place). -/
  usable : ∀ l ∈ ls, LeafOfUsable s l
  /-- §68.1: every leaf of the region is declared `K.SharedMutable`. -/
  shared : ∀ l ∈ ls, k.SharedMutable l
  /-- §68.2: `access` is exercisable in a mode at least `Observe`. -/
  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt a .observe
  /-- §68.2: `access` has a present effective mode on every leaf. -/
  effectivePresent : ∀ l ∈ ls, effective s a l ≠ none
  /-- §68.3: dependencies are valid. -/
  depsValid : ∀ l ∈ ls, DepsValid s l

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `writeShared` (§68). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) :
    Decidable (WriteSharedPre k s a ls) :=
  decidable_of_iff ((∀ l ∈ ls, LeafOfUsable s l) ∧ (∀ l ∈ ls, k.SharedMutable l) ∧
    s.ExercisableAt a .observe ∧ (∀ l ∈ ls, effective s a l ≠ none) ∧ (∀ l ∈ ls, DepsValid s l))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩

/-- `writeShared` as a relation (§68). -/
def WriteSharedStep (k : K) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (WriteSharedPre k s a ls) (write3Eff s ls)

/-! ## Release of authorities whose holder dies (§69, §70) -/

/-- Releases every authority whose holder is no longer live (§69, §70 `ok` effects). -/
def cleanup (s : S3) : S3 :=
  { s with A := s.A.map fun y => if HolderLive s y.holder then y else { y with active := false } }

/-! ## O12 `endUse` (§69) -/

/-- `endUse p` before releasing authorities whose holder died (§69, `ok` effect): the leaves of
`p` become `Uninit`; authorities held within `p` are released; anchors of `p` and its parts are
removed; storage owned by `p`, transitively, is marked dead. -/
def endUseS (s : S3) (p : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with
    I := fun l => if l ∈ footprint s.P p then .uninit else s.I l
    D := fun q => if partOf s.P q p then [] else s.D q
    dead := fun q => s.dead q || decide (OwnedIn s.P p q)
    A := s.A.map fun y => if heldIn s.P p y.holder then { y with active := false } else y }

/-- Effect of `endUse p` (§69, `ok` effect): `endUseS`, then the authorities whose holder died
are released. -/
def endUseEff (s : S3) (p : Nat) : S3 := cleanup (endUseS s p)

/-- Leaf whose use ends with the value at `p` (§69.2, §69.4): a leaf of `p` or of storage that
stops being usable. -/
def EndingLeaf (s : S3) (p l : Nat) : Prop :=
  l ∈ footprint s.P p ∨ (isLeaf s.P l ∧ s.Usable l ∧ ¬ (endUseS s p).Usable l)

/-- Decidability of `EndingLeaf` (§69). -/
instance (s : S3) (p l : Nat) : Decidable (EndingLeaf s p l) := by
  unfold EndingLeaf; infer_instance

/-- Root authority of the value at `p` (§69.3): an authority with no origin covering a leaf of
`p`. -/
def IsRootOf (s : S3) (p : Nat) (y : Authority) : Prop :=
  y.origin = none ∧ ∃ l ∈ footprint s.P p, l ∈ y.footprint

/-- Decidability of `IsRootOf` (§69.3). -/
instance (s : S3) (p : Nat) (y : Authority) : Decidable (IsRootOf s p y) := by
  unfold IsRootOf; infer_instance

/-- Authority `j` does not block `endUse p` (§69.2): if it is an active derived authority over an
ending leaf, it is held within `p` or its holder dies. -/
def EndUseAccessOK (s : S3) (p j : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.origin ≠ none →
    (∃ l ∈ y.footprint, EndingLeaf s p l) →
      heldIn s.P p y.holder ∨ ¬ HolderLive (endUseS s p) y.holder) True

/-- Decidability of `EndUseAccessOK` (§69.2). -/
instance (s : S3) (p j : Nat) : Decidable (EndUseAccessOK s p j) := by
  unfold EndUseAccessOK OptP; split <;> infer_instance

/-- Anchor `x` survives `endUse p` (§69.3): not held within `p`, not a root of `p`, with a holder
that stays live. -/
def EndUseAnchorOK (s : S3) (p x : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => ¬ heldIn s.P p y.holder ∧ ¬ IsRootOf s p y ∧
    HolderLive (endUseS s p) y.holder) True

/-- Decidability of `EndUseAnchorOK` (§69.3). -/
instance (s : S3) (p x : Nat) : Decidable (EndUseAnchorOK s p x) := by
  unfold EndUseAnchorOK OptP; split <;> infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `endUse` (§69). -/
structure EndUsePre (k : K) (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §69.1: `place` is usable. -/
  usable : s.Usable p
  /-- §69.1: exercisable `Modify` over `place`. -/
  right : HasRight s .modify p
  /-- §69.2: no active derived authority over an ending leaf is held outside the dying places,
  except the authorities through which the step exercises its `Modify` right over `place`: some
  authority grounding that right and its origin chain. -/
  access : ∃ g ∈ List.range s.A.length, Grounds s .modify p g ∧
    ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, RightChain s g j ∨ EndUseAccessOK s p j
  /-- §69.2, last sentence: no authority that the effect makes inactive has an active descendant
  that the effect does not make inactive. -/
  keptDesc : ∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, s.Active a →
    ¬ (endUseEff s p).Active a → a ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ (endUseEff s p).Active j
  /-- §69.3: no place usable after the effect depends on an authority held by `place`, its root,
  or an authority whose holder dies. -/
  anchors : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (endUseS s p).Usable q →
    ∀ x ∈ (endUseS s p).D q, EndUseAnchorOK s p x
  /-- §69.4: no ending leaf, owned storage included, is pinned, statically or dynamically. -/
  notPinned : ∀ l ∈ List.range s.P.length, EndingLeaf s p l → s.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `endUse` (§69). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Decidable (EndUsePre k s p) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Usable p ∧ HasRight s .modify p ∧
    (∃ g ∈ List.range s.A.length, Grounds s .modify p g ∧
      ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, RightChain s g j ∨ EndUseAccessOK s p j) ∧
    (∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, s.Active a →
      ¬ (endUseEff s p).Active a → a ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ (endUseEff s p).Active j) ∧
    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (endUseS s p).Usable q →
      ∀ x ∈ (endUseS s p).D q, EndUseAnchorOK s p x) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ List.range s.P.length, EndingLeaf s p l → s.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩⟩

/-- `endUse` as a relation (§69). -/
def EndUseStep (k : K) (p : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (EndUsePre k s p) (endUseEff s p)

/-! ## O13 `free` (§70) -/

/-- The holder is a place (§70.1). -/
def Holder.isPlace : Holder → Bool
  | .place _ => true
  | .frame _ => false

/-- `OwnedRoot` (§70.1): a place with no structural parent, owned by a place. -/
def OwnedRoot (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.P[p]?) (fun pl => pl.parent = none ∧ pl.owner.isPlace = true) False

/-- Decidability of `OwnedRoot` (§70.1). -/
instance (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Decidable (OwnedRoot s p) := by
  unfold OwnedRoot; infer_instance

/-- Place `q` belongs to the unit released by `free p` (§70): a part of `p`, or storage owned by
`p`, transitively. -/
def FreedPlace (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Prop := partOf P q p ∨ OwnedIn P p q

/-- Decidability of `FreedPlace` (§70). -/
instance (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Decidable (FreedPlace P p q) := by
  unfold FreedPlace; infer_instance

/-- `free p` before releasing authorities whose holder died (§70, `ok` effect): the released unit
is marked dead; authorities covering it, roots included, or held within `p` become inactive. -/
def freeS (s : S3) (p : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with
    dead := fun q => s.dead q || decide (FreedPlace s.P p q)
    A := s.A.map fun y =>
      if (∃ l ∈ y.footprint, FreedPlace s.P p l) ∨ heldIn s.P p y.holder then
        { y with active := false } else y }

/-- Effect of `free p` (§70, `ok` effect): `freeS`, then the authorities whose holder died are
released. -/
def freeEff (s : S3) (p : Nat) : S3 := cleanup (freeS s p)

/-- Leaf of the released unit (§70.3, §70.4): a leaf of `p` or of storage that stops being
usable. -/
def FreedLeaf (s : S3) (p l : Nat) : Prop :=
  l ∈ footprint s.P p ∨ (isLeaf s.P l ∧ s.Usable l ∧ ¬ (freeS s p).Usable l)

/-- Decidability of `FreedLeaf` (§70). -/
instance (s : S3) (p l : Nat) : Decidable (FreedLeaf s p l) := by
  unfold FreedLeaf; infer_instance

/-- Authority `j` does not block `free p` (§70.3): if it is an active derivative over the
footprint being freed, it is held within `p` or its holder dies. -/
def FreeAccessOK (s : S3) (p j : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.origin ≠ none →
    (∃ l ∈ y.footprint, FreedLeaf s p l) →
      heldIn s.P p y.holder ∨ ¬ HolderLive (freeS s p) y.holder) True

/-- Decidability of `FreeAccessOK` (§70.3). -/
instance (s : S3) (p j : Nat) : Decidable (FreeAccessOK s p j) := by
  unfold FreeAccessOK OptP; split <;> infer_instance

/-- Anchor `x` survives `free p` (§70.3): it covers no leaf of the released unit, is not held
within `p`, and its holder stays live. -/
def FreeAnchorOK (s : S3) (p x : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => ¬ (∃ l ∈ y.footprint, FreedPlace s.P p l) ∧ ¬ heldIn s.P p y.holder ∧
    HolderLive (freeS s p) y.holder) True

/-- Decidability of `FreeAnchorOK` (§70.3). -/
instance (s : S3) (p x : Nat) : Decidable (FreeAnchorOK s p x) := by
  unfold FreeAnchorOK OptP; split <;> infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `free p auth` (§70). -/
structure FreePre (k : K) (s : S3) (p auth : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §70.1: `place` is an `OwnedRoot`. -/
  ownedRoot : OwnedRoot s p
  /-- §70.2: `K.Deallocable(place)`. -/
  deallocable : k.Deallocable p
  /-- §70.2: `K.FreeCompat(place, auth)`. -/
  freeCompat : k.FreeCompat p auth
  /-- §70.3: exercisable `Modify` over `place`. -/
  right : HasRight s .modify p
  /-- §70.3: no active derivative over the footprint being freed is held outside dying holders,
  except the authorities through which the step exercises its `Modify` right over `place`: some
  authority grounding that right and its origin chain. -/
  access : ∃ g ∈ List.range s.A.length, Grounds s .modify p g ∧
    ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, RightChain s g j ∨ FreeAccessOK s p j
  /-- §70.3, last sentence: no authority that the effect makes inactive has an active descendant
  that the effect does not make inactive. -/
  keptDesc : ∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, s.Active a →
    ¬ (freeEff s p).Active a → a ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ (freeEff s p).Active j
  /-- §70.3: no surviving place is anchored to an authority of the released unit or of its dead
  holders. -/
  anchors : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (freeS s p).Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, FreeAnchorOK s p x
  /-- §70.4: no leaf of the released unit is pinned, statically or dynamically. -/
  notPinned : ∀ l ∈ List.range s.P.length, FreedLeaf s p l → s.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `free` (§70). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.Deallocable]
    [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] (s : S3) (p auth : Nat) :
    Decidable (FreePre k s p auth) :=
  decidable_of_iff (OwnedRoot s p ∧ k.Deallocable p ∧ k.FreeCompat p auth ∧
    HasRight s .modify p ∧
    (∃ g ∈ List.range s.A.length, Grounds s .modify p g ∧
      ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, RightChain s g j ∨ FreeAccessOK s p j) ∧
    (∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, s.Active a →
      ¬ (freeEff s p).Active a → a ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ (freeEff s p).Active j) ∧
    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (freeS s p).Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, FreeAnchorOK s p x) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ List.range s.P.length, FreedLeaf s p l → s.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩⟩

/-- `free` as a relation (§70). -/
def FreeStep (k : K) (p auth : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (FreePre k s p auth) (freeEff s p)

/-! ## O14 `alloc` (§71) -/

/-- Static preconditions of `alloc provider owner shape` (§71, items 1–3). -/
structure AllocStatic (k : K) (s : S3) (provider owner : Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : Prop where
  /-- §71.1: the shape is nonempty. -/
  nonempty : ls ≠ []
  /-- §71.1: the shape is represented like the locals of `enterFrame` (each parent is an earlier
  element). -/
  shapeOK : ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape
  /-- §71.1 with the `ok` outcome of §71 ("a new storage root"): exactly one element has no
  parent. -/
  oneRoot : (rootIdx ls.toShape).length = 1
  /-- §71.2: the provider is a usable place. -/
  providerUsable : s.Usable provider
  /-- §71.2: all leaves of the provider are `Init`. -/
  providerInit : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P provider, s.I l = .init
  /-- §71.2: metadata updates are permitted through exercisable `Modify` on the provider or a
  valid `writeShared` (§68) over its leaves. -/
  providerRight : HasRight s .modify provider ∨
    ∃ via ∈ List.range s.A.length, WriteSharedPre k s via (footprint s.P provider)
  /-- §71.3: exercisable `Modify` over `owner`. -/
  ownerRight : HasRight s .modify owner
  /-- §71.3 (liveness restrictions): `owner` is usable. -/
  ownerUsable : s.Usable owner

/-- Decidability of the static preconditions of `alloc` (§71). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (provider owner : Nat)
    (ls : LocalShape) : Decidable (AllocStatic k s provider owner ls) :=
  decidable_of_iff (ls ≠ [] ∧ ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape ∧ (rootIdx ls.toShape).length = 1 ∧
    s.Usable provider ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P provider, s.I l = .init) ∧
    (HasRight s .modify provider ∨
      ∃ via ∈ List.range s.A.length, WriteSharedPre k s via (footprint s.P provider)) ∧
    HasRight s .modify owner ∧ s.Usable owner)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩⟩

/-- Places after `alloc` (§71, `ok` outcome): the elements of the shape appended, owned by
`owner`. -/
def allocP (s : S3) (owner : Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : List Place :=
  shapeP s.P (.place owner) ls.toShape

/-- Effect of `alloc` (§71, `ok` outcome): a new storage root of fresh identities owned by
`owner`, its leaves `Uninit`, no anchor, alive, with a root `Modify` authority with no origin held
by `owner`; pinning obligations are unchanged. -/
def allocEff (s : S3) (owner : Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : S3 :=
  { s with
    P := allocP s owner ls
    I := fun l => if s.P.length ≤ l then .uninit else s.I l
    A := s.A ++ (rootIdx ls.toShape).map fun i =>
      ⟨.modify, none, footprint (allocP s owner ls) (s.P.length + i),
        shapeOwner ls.toShape (.place owner) i, true⟩
    D := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then [] else s.D q
    dead := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then false else s.dead q }

/-- `alloc provider owner shape` as a relation (§71 outcomes, §58): `reject` when a static
precondition fails; `fail`, state unchanged, when `K.Satisfiable` is false; `ok` otherwise. -/
inductive AllocStep (k : K) (provider owner : Nat) (ls : LocalShape) (s : S3) :
    Outcome3 S3 → Prop where
  | ok : AllocStatic k s provider owner ls → k.Satisfiable provider ls s →
      AllocStep k provider owner ls s (.ok (allocEff s owner ls))
  | fail : AllocStatic k s provider owner ls → ¬ k.Satisfiable provider ls s →
      AllocStep k provider owner ls s .fail
  | reject : ¬ AllocStatic k s provider owner ls → AllocStep k provider owner ls s .reject

/-! ## O15 `pin`, O16 `unpin` (§74, §75) -/

/-- Preconditions of `pin` (§74). "Applicable pinning obligations" is not represented. -/
structure PinPre (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §74: `place` is usable. -/
  usable : s.Usable p
  /-- §74: exercisable `Modify` over the leaves of `place`. -/
  right : HasRight s .modify p

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `pin` (§74). -/
instance (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Decidable (PinPre s p) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Usable p ∧ HasRight s .modify p)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩, fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩⟩

/-- Effect of `pin` (§74, `ok` effect): an active dynamic pinning obligation of fresh identity
`|pins|` is installed on the leaves of `place`. -/
def pinEff (s : S3) (p : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with pins := s.pins ++ [⟨p, footprint s.P p, true⟩] }

/-- `pin` as a relation (§74). -/
def PinStep (p : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop := Guarded (PinPre s p) (pinEff s p)

/-- Effect of `unpin` (§75, `ok` effect): the designated obligation `o` ends, and only that
one. -/
def unpinEff (s : S3) (o : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with pins := s.pins.modify o fun ob => { ob with active := false } }

/-- Preconditions of `unpin o` (§75), `o` the identity of a dynamic pinning obligation. -/
structure UnpinPre (k : K) (s : S3) (o : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §75: `unpin` designates an active dynamic pinning obligation. -/
  active : OptP (s.pins[o]?) (fun ob => ob.active = true) False
  /-- §75: `place`, on which the obligation was installed by `pin`, is usable. -/
  usable : OptP (s.pins[o]?) (fun ob => s.Usable ob.place) False
  /-- §75: exercisable `Modify` over `place`. -/
  right : OptP (s.pins[o]?) (fun ob => HasRight s .modify ob.place) False
  /-- §75: `K.ExternalDone`, applied to the obligation. -/
  externalDone : k.ExternalDone o

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `unpin` (§75). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] (s : S3) (o : Nat) :
    Decidable (UnpinPre k s o) :=
  decidable_of_iff (OptP (s.pins[o]?) (fun ob => ob.active = true) False ∧
    OptP (s.pins[o]?) (fun ob => s.Usable ob.place) False ∧
    OptP (s.pins[o]?) (fun ob => HasRight s .modify ob.place) False ∧ k.ExternalDone o)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d⟩⟩

/-- `unpin` as a relation (§75). -/
def UnpinStep (k : K) (o : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (UnpinPre k s o) (unpinEff s o)

/-! ## Kernel steps (§57, §58) -/

/-- One `ok` transition of a kernel operation O1–O16 (§60–§75; §57 reachability). -/
inductive KStep (k : K) : S3 → S3 → Prop where
  | derive {s s' : S3} {src : Nat} {region : List Nat} {m : Mode} :
      DeriveStep src region m s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | split {s s' : S3} {src : Nat} {rs : List (List Nat)} :
      SplitStep k src rs s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | release {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} : ReleaseStep a s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | transfer {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat} : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | depend {s s' : S3} {q x : Nat} : DependStep q x s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | enter {s s' : S3} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape} :
      EnterStep ps ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | exit {s s' : S3} : ExitStep k s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | read {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} : Read3Step a ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | write {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} : Write3Step a ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | writeShared {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} :
      WriteSharedStep k a ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | pin {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} : PinStep p s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | unpin {s s' : S3} {o : Nat} : UnpinStep k o s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'

  | store {s s' : S3} {a p : Nat} : StoreStep a p s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'

end Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-- Strict ancestors of `i` along `org` (§40, §42); fuel `i` suffices since the chain
decreases. -/
def chain (org : Nat → Option Nat) (i : Nat) : List Nat := chainF org i i

/-! ## Places, leaves, footprints (§40) -/

/-- Holder of an authority (§42) or owner of a place (§40): a frame or a place. -/
inductive Holder where
  | frame (f : Nat)
  | place (p : Nat)
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Logical place (§40): optional structural parent, owner, abstract `kind`. Its identity is its
index in `P`; its death marker is `S3.dead`. -/
structure Place where
  parent : Option Nat
  owner : Holder
  kind : Nat
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Structural parent of place `i` (§40). -/
def parentOf (P : List Place) (i : Nat) : Option Nat := (P[i]?).bind (·.parent)

/-- `partOf(p, q)` (§40): `p` is a place of `P` and `q` is `p` or one of its structural
ancestors. -/
def partOf (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Prop :=
  p < P.length ∧ (p = q ∨ q ∈ chain (parentOf P) p)

/-- Decidability of `partOf` (§40). -/
instance (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Decidable (partOf P p q) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∧ _))

/-- Leaf (§40): a place with no structural child. -/
def isLeaf (P : List Place) (l : Nat) : Prop := ∀ r < P.length, parentOf P r ≠ some l

/-- Decidability of `isLeaf` (§40). -/
instance (P : List Place) (l : Nat) : Decidable (isLeaf P l) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (∀ _, _))

/-- `footprint(q)` (§40): the leaves of `P` that are parts of `q`. -/
def footprint (P : List Place) (q : Nat) : List Nat :=
  (List.range P.length).filter fun l => decide (isLeaf P l ∧ partOf P l q)

/-- Two places overlap when their footprints share a leaf (§63.3). -/
def overlap (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Prop := ∃ l ∈ footprint P p, l ∈ footprint P q

/-- Decidability of `overlap` (§63.3). -/
instance (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Decidable (overlap P p q) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (∃ _ ∈ _, _))

/-- `OwnedIn P src q` (§40, §33): the ownership chain of `q` reaches a place owned by `src` or by
one of its parts, that is, `q` is storage owned, directly or transitively, by the value at
`src`. -/
inductive OwnedIn (P : List Place) (src : Nat) : Nat → Prop where
  | direct {q o : Nat} {pl : Place} : P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .place o → partOf P o src →
      OwnedIn P src q
  | step {q o : Nat} {pl : Place} : P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .place o → OwnedIn P src o →
      OwnedIn P src q

/-! ## State (§38, §41, §42) -/

/-- Initialization state of a leaf (§41). -/
inductive InitSt where
  | uninit
  | init
  | moved
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Mode of an authority or of a request (§42, §43). -/
inductive Mode where
  | observe
  | modify
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Order of requested modes, `Observe ≤ Modify` (§43). -/
def Mode.le (m m' : Mode) : Prop := m = .observe ∨ m' = .modify

/-- Decidability of the mode order (§43). -/
instance (m m' : Mode) : Decidable (m.le m') := inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∨ _))

/-- Authority (§42): own mode, optional origin, footprint (a list of leaves read
extensionally), holder, activity. Its identity is its index in `A`. -/
structure Authority where
  mode : Mode
  origin : Option Nat
  footprint : List Nat
  holder : Holder
  active : Bool
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Dynamic pinning obligation (§74, §75): the place `pin` was applied to, the leaves it pins, and
whether it is still active. Its identity is its index in `S3.pins`. -/
structure PinOb where
  place : Nat
  leaves : List Nat
  active : Bool
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- State `S3` (§38). `F`, `P`, `I`, `A`, `D` are the components of §38. `nF` (next fresh frame
identity, §39), `dead` (death marker of places, §40) and `pins` (dynamic pinning obligations,
§74, §75) are auxiliary information that creates no right (§38). -/
structure S3 where
  F : Frames
  nF : Nat
  P : List Place
  I : Nat → InitSt
  A : List Authority
  D : Nat → List Nat
  dead : Nat → Bool
  pins : List PinOb

/-- Leaf `l` is dynamically pinned (§74): an active pinning obligation covers it. -/
def S3.pin (s : S3) (l : Nat) : Bool := s.pins.any fun o => o.active && o.leaves.contains l

/-- Shape of the locals of `enterFrame` (§72) and of an allocation (§71.1): each element is an
optional structural parent (a place index) and a `kind`. Every element is owned by the holder
receiving the shape. -/
abbrev LocalShape := List (Option Nat × Nat)

/-- External contract `K` (§48, §80): `DeclaredDisjoint` on regions (§23, §61.3);
`SharedMutable` and `Pinned` on leaves (§68.1, §63.5); `ExternalDone` on dynamic pinning
obligations, by identity (§75); `Deallocable` on places (§70.2); `FreeCompat place auth` (§70.2);
`Satisfiable provider shape s` (§71). Obligations of `K` are hypotheses of theorems, never
fields. -/
structure K where
  DeclaredDisjoint : List Nat → List Nat → Prop
  SharedMutable : Nat → Prop
  Pinned : Nat → Prop
  ExternalDone : Nat → Prop
  Deallocable : Nat → Prop
  FreeCompat : Nat → Nat → Prop
  Satisfiable : Nat → LocalShape → S3 → Prop

/-- `DDSound(K)` (§80, §23): no declared disjointness relates two regions sharing a leaf. -/
def DDSound (k : K) : Prop := ∀ r r', k.DeclaredDisjoint r r' → ∀ l ∈ r, l ∉ r'

/-- `origin` link of authority `i` (§42). -/
def S3.org (s : S3) (i : Nat) : Option Nat := (s.A[i]?).bind (·.origin)

/-- Strict ancestors of authority `i` along its origin chain (§42, §43). -/
def S3.ancs (s : S3) (i : Nat) : List Nat := chain s.org i

/-- Effective anchor of `x` (§44): the root reached along its origin chain, the last element of
`x :: s.ancs x`. -/
def S3.effAnchor (s : S3) (x : Nat) : Nat := (s.ancs x).getLastD x

/-- Active authority (§42); as an anchor, a valid anchor (§44). -/
def S3.Active (s : S3) (x : Nat) : Prop := ∃ y, s.A[x]? = some y ∧ y.active = true

/-- Decidability of `S3.Active` (§42, §44). -/
instance (s : S3) (x : Nat) : Decidable (s.Active x) :=
  match h : s.A[x]? with
  | some y => if hy : y.active = true then isTrue ⟨y, h, hy⟩
    else isFalse fun ⟨y', h', hy'⟩ => by rw [h] at h'; cases h'; exact hy hy'
  | none => isFalse fun ⟨_, h', _⟩ => by rw [h] at h'; cases h'

/-- Current frame, the top of the stack (§39). -/
def S3.top (s : S3) : Nat := s.F.headD 0

/-! ## Decidable helpers -/

/-- Predicate on an optional value, `P y` for `some y` and `d` for `none`; used to read the
components of `S3` (§38). -/
def OptP {α : Type} (o : Option α) (P : α → Prop) (d : Prop) : Prop :=
  match o with
  | some y => P y
  | none => d

/-- Decidability of `OptP` (§38). -/
/-- Decidability of `Allows` (§43). -/
instance (e : Option Mode) (m : Mode) : Decidable (Allows e m) := by
  unfold Allows; infer_instance

/-- Footprint of authority `a` (§42), empty if it does not exist. -/
def S3.afp (s : S3) (a : Nat) : List Nat := match s.A[a]? with
  | some x => x.footprint
  | none => []

/-- Adds an authority with fresh identity `s.A.length` (§42, §60). -/
def S3.addAuth (s : S3) (y : Authority) : S3 := { s with A := s.A ++ [y] }

/-! ## Footprints and frames of places (§40) -/

/-- Membership in `footprint(q)` (§40): an existing leaf that is a part of `q`. -/
theorem mem_footprint {P : List Place} {q l : Nat} :
    l ∈ footprint P q ↔ l < P.length ∧ isLeaf P l ∧ partOf P l q := by
  simp [footprint, List.mem_filter, List.mem_range]

/-- Footprints depend only on the number of places and on structural parents (§40). -/
theorem footprint_congr {P P' : List Place} (hlen : P'.length = P.length)
    (hpar : parentOf P' = parentOf P) (q : Nat) : footprint P' q = footprint P q := by
  unfold footprint; rw [hlen]; congr 1; funext l
  exact decide_eq_decide.2 (by simp only [isLeaf, partOf, hpar, hlen])

/-- The frame of a place is unique (§40, `placeFrame`). -/
theorem FrameOf.det {s : S3} {q f f' : Nat} (h : FrameOf s q f) (h' : FrameOf s q f') :
    f = f' := by
theorem transfer_P_get (s : S3) (src dst q : Nat) :
    (transferEff s src dst).P[q]? = (s.P[q]?).map fun pl =>
      if heldIn s.P src pl.owner then { pl with owner := mvTo s.P src dst pl.owner } else pl := by
  simp [transferEff]

/-- Authorities after a transfer: holders within `src` move to the corresponding part of `dst`
(§63, `ok` effect). -/
theorem transfer_A_get (s : S3) (src dst j : Nat) :
    (transferEff s src dst).A[j]? = (s.A[j]?).map fun y =>
      if heldIn s.P src y.holder then { y with holder := mvTo s.P src dst y.holder } else y := by
  simp [transferEff]

/-- A transfer keeps the number of places (§63). -/
theorem transfer_len (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) :
    (transferEff s src dst).P.length = s.P.length := by simp [transferEff]

/-- A transfer keeps the structural parents (§63). -/
theorem transfer_parentOf (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) :
    parentOf (transferEff s src dst).P = parentOf s.P := by
  funext i; simp only [parentOf, transfer_P_get]
  cases s.P[i]? with
  | none => rfl
  | some pl => simp only [Option.map_some, Option.bind_some]; split <;> rfl

/-- A transfer keeps the footprints (§63). -/
theorem transfer_footprint (s : S3) (src dst q : Nat) :
    footprint (transferEff s src dst).P q = footprint s.P q :=
  footprint_congr (transfer_len s src dst) (transfer_parentOf s src dst) q

/-- A transfer keeps the structural parts (§63). -/
theorem transfer_partOf (s : S3) (src dst r q : Nat) :
    partOf (transferEff s src dst).P r q ↔ partOf s.P r q := by
  simp only [partOf, transfer_parentOf, transfer_len]

  | some y => simp only [Option.map_some]; split <;> rfl

/-- A place usable after a transfer of a usable `src` was usable before (§40, §63). -/
theorem transfer_usable_back {s : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hwf : WF3 s) (hsrc : s.Usable src)
  simp [splitEff, S3.addAuth, S3.top]

/-! ## Same authorities up to holders (§42, §63) -/

/-- Skeleton of an authority (§42): every field but its holder. -/
def skel (z : Authority) : Mode × Option Nat × List Nat × Bool :=
  (z.mode, z.origin, z.footprint, z.active)

/-- `s'` has the authorities of `s` up to their holders (§42; §63: a transfer creates and
duplicates no authority). -/
def SameSkel (s s' : S3) : Prop :=
  s'.A.length = s.A.length ∧ ∀ j : Nat, (s'.A[j]?).map skel = (s.A[j]?).map skel

/-- An authority of `s'` has a counterpart in `s` with the same skeleton (§42). -/
theorem SameSkel.get {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') {j : Nat} {y' : Authority}
    (hj : s'.A[j]? = some y') : ∃ y, s.A[j]? = some y ∧ skel y' = skel y := by
  have := h.2 j; rw [hj] at this
  cases hy : s.A[j]? with
  | none => rw [hy] at this; cases this
  | some y => rw [hy] at this; exact ⟨y, rfl, Option.some.inj this⟩

/-- An authority of `s` has a counterpart in `s'` with the same skeleton (§42). -/
theorem SameSkel.get' {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') {j : Nat} {y : Authority}
    (hj : s.A[j]? = some y) : ∃ y', s'.A[j]? = some y' ∧ skel y' = skel y := by
  have := h.2 j; rw [hj] at this
  cases hy : s'.A[j]? with
  | none => rw [hy] at this; cases this
  | some y' => rw [hy] at this; exact ⟨y', rfl, Option.some.inj this⟩

/-- Same skeletons give the same origin links (§42). -/
theorem SameSkel.org {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') : s'.org = s.org := by
  funext j
  cases hy : s.A[j]? with
  | none =>
    cases hy' : s'.A[j]? with
    | none => simp [S3.org, hy, hy']
    | some y' => obtain ⟨y, h1, -⟩ := h.get hy'; rw [hy] at h1; cases h1
  | some y => obtain ⟨y', hy', e⟩ := h.get' hy; simp [skel] at e; simp [S3.org, hy, hy', e.2.1]

/-- Same skeletons give the same origin chains (§42). -/
theorem SameSkel.ancs {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') : s'.ancs = s.ancs := by
  funext j; simp [S3.ancs, h.org]

/-- Same skeletons give the same active authorities (§42). -/
theorem SameSkel.active {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') {x : Nat} :
    s'.Active x ↔ s.Active x := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y', hy', ha⟩; obtain ⟨y, hy, he⟩ := h.get hy'
    exact ⟨y, hy, by simp [skel] at he; rw [← he.2.2.2]; exact ha⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, ha⟩; obtain ⟨y', hy', he⟩ := h.get' hy
    exact ⟨y', hy', by simp [skel] at he; rw [he.2.2.2]; exact ha⟩

/-- Same skeletons give the same covering descendants (§43). -/
theorem SameSkel.descModes {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') (a p : Nat) :
    descModes s' a p = descModes s a p := by
  unfold Access.descModes; rw [h.1, h.ancs]
  refine filterMap_congr' fun j _ => ?_
  cases hy : s.A[j]? with
  | none => have := h.2 j; rw [hy] at this; cases hy' : s'.A[j]? <;> simp_all
  | some y =>
    obtain ⟨y', hy', he⟩ := h.get' hy
    simp [skel] at he; simp [hy', he]

/-- Same skeletons give the same effective modes (§43). -/
theorem SameSkel.effective {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') (a p : Nat) :
    effective s' a p = effective s a p := by
  unfold Access.effective; rw [h.descModes]
  cases hy : s.A[a]? with
  | none => have := h.2 a; rw [hy] at this; cases hy' : s'.A[a]? <;> simp_all
  | some y =>
    obtain ⟨y', hy', he⟩ := h.get' hy
    simp [skel] at he; simp [hy', he]

/-- `I1` depends only on the skeletons (§50). -/
theorem SameSkel.i1 {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') (h1 : I1 s) : I1 s' := by
  intro a b x' y' p hab ha hb xa ya xp yp hnab hnba
  obtain ⟨x, hx, ex⟩ := h.get ha; obtain ⟨y, hy, ey⟩ := h.get hb
  simp [skel] at ex ey; rw [h.ancs] at hnab hnba
  rw [ex.1, ey.1]
  exact h1 a b x y p hab hx hy (ex.2.2.2 ▸ xa) (ey.2.2.2 ▸ ya) (ex.2.2.1 ▸ xp) (ey.2.2.1 ▸ yp)
    hnab hnba

/-- `I2` depends only on the skeletons (§51). -/
theorem SameSkel.i2 {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') (h2 : I2 s) : I2 s' := by
  intro b y a hb ho
  obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, e⟩ := h.get hb; simp [skel] at e
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀, hm, hh, ha⟩ := h2 b y₀ a hy₀ (e.2.1 ▸ ho)
  obtain ⟨x', hx', e'⟩ := h.get' hx₀; simp [skel] at e'
  exact ⟨x', hx', by rw [e.1, e'.1]; exact hm,
    fun p hp => by rw [e'.2.2.1]; exact hh p (e.2.2.1 ▸ hp),
    fun ya => by rw [e'.2.2.2]; exact ha (e.2.2.2 ▸ ya)⟩

/-- The origin clause of `WF3` depends only on the skeletons (§49.5). -/
theorem SameSkel.origins {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s')
    (hw : ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a → a < b) :
    ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s'.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a → a < b := by
  intro b y a hb ho
  obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, e⟩ := h.get hb; simp [skel] at e
  exact hw b y₀ a hy₀ (e.2.1 ▸ ho)

/-- A property of every footprint member depends only on the skeletons (§49.4). -/
theorem SameSkel.footprints {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') {Q : Nat → Prop}
    (hw : ∀ (a : Nat) (x : Authority), s.A[a]? = some x → ∀ l ∈ x.footprint, Q l) :
    ∀ (a : Nat) (x : Authority), s'.A[a]? = some x → ∀ l ∈ x.footprint, Q l := by
  intro a x hx l hl
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀, e⟩ := h.get hx; simp [skel] at e
  exact hw a x₀ hx₀ l (e.2.2.1 ▸ hl)

/-! ## `release` (§62) -/

/-- Element `j` after setting element `a` (§62, §65 effects). -/
theorem set_get {l : List Authority} {a j : Nat} {x' : Authority} (ha : a < l.length) :
    (l.set a x')[j]? = if a = j then some x' else l[j]? := by
  rw [List.getElem?_set]; split <;> simp_all

import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Preserve.Common

/-!
# Access kernel: `alloc` (O14)

Results on `alloc provider owner shape` of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md` §71
and on the outcomes of §58: the `ok` outcome preserves the main invariant of §57 (`KInv`),
separately its auxiliary `KAux`, and `I5` (§57); it adds exactly one root place and exactly one authority, the root
`Modify` authority of that place, with no origin, held by `owner`, the new leaves `Uninit` (§71,
`ok`); `fail` happens only when the static preconditions hold and `K.Satisfiable` is false, and
produces no new state (§58, §71); `alloc` is deterministic; no other kernel operation O1–O16
yields `fail` (§58). Helper lemmas live in the namespace `Alloc`.
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access

namespace Alloc

/-! ## Shape of the new places (§71.1, §71 `ok`) -/

/-- Every element of a local shape is owned by the receiving holder (§71.1: the shape is
represented like the locals of `enterFrame`, which have no owning element). -/
theorem shapeOwner_toShape (ls : LocalShape) (hd : Holder) (i : Nat) :
    shapeOwner ls.toShape hd i = hd := by
  simp only [shapeOwner, LocalShape.toShape, List.getElem?_map]
  cases ls[i]? <;> rfl

/-- A local shape has one element per entry (§71.1). -/
theorem length_toShape (ls : LocalShape) : ls.toShape.length = ls.length := by
  simp [LocalShape.toShape]

/-- The places after `alloc` are the former places followed by the elements of the shape (§71,
`ok`: fresh identities). -/
theorem allocP_len (s : S3) (ow : Nat) (ls : LocalShape) :
    (allocP s ow ls).length = s.P.length + ls.length := by
  simp [allocP, shapeP, LocalShape.toShape]

/-- `alloc` keeps the former places (§71, `ok`). -/
theorem allocP_lt {s : S3} {ow : Nat} {ls : LocalShape} {q : Nat} (h : q < s.P.length) :
    (allocP s ow ls)[q]? = s.P[q]? := List.getElem?_append_left h

/-- The new place of index `|P| + i` has the parent given by the shape and is owned by `owner`
(§71, `ok`: owned by `owner`). -/
theorem allocP_new {s : S3} {ow : Nat} {ls : LocalShape} {i : Nat} (h : i < ls.length) :
    (allocP s ow ls)[s.P.length + i]? =
      some ⟨(ls.toShape[i]?).bind (·.1), .place ow, ((ls.toShape[i]?).map (·.2.2)).getD 0⟩ := by
  have h' : i < ls.toShape.length := by rw [length_toShape]; exact h
  simp only [allocP, shapeP, List.getElem?_append_right (Nat.le_add_right _ _),
    Nat.add_sub_cancel_left, List.getElem?_map, List.getElem?_range h', Option.map_some,
    shapeOwner_toShape]

/-- A place after `alloc` is a former place, or a new element of the shape owned by `owner`
(§71, `ok`). -/
theorem allocP_get {s : S3} {ow : Nat} {ls : LocalShape} {q : Nat} {pl : Place}
    (h : (allocP s ow ls)[q]? = some pl) :
    (q < s.P.length ∧ s.P[q]? = some pl) ∨
    (s.P.length ≤ q ∧ q < s.P.length + ls.length ∧
      pl.parent = (ls.toShape[q - s.P.length]?).bind (·.1) ∧ pl.owner = .place ow) := by
  by_cases hq : q < s.P.length
  · exact .inl ⟨hq, by rwa [allocP_lt hq] at h⟩
  · have hlt := lt_of_getElem? h
    rw [allocP_len] at hlt
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ : ∃ i, q = s.P.length + i := ⟨q - s.P.length, by omega⟩
    rw [allocP_new (by omega)] at h
    cases h
    exact .inr ⟨by omega, hlt, by simp, rfl⟩

/-- `alloc` keeps the parents of the former places (§71, `ok`). -/
theorem parentOf_lt {s : S3} {ow : Nat} {ls : LocalShape} {q : Nat} (h : q < s.P.length) :
    parentOf (allocP s ow ls) q = parentOf s.P q := by
  simp only [parentOf, allocP_lt h]

/-- The parent of a new place is the one given by the shape (§71.1). -/
theorem parentOf_new {s : S3} {ow : Nat} {ls : LocalShape} {i : Nat} (h : i < ls.length) :
    parentOf (allocP s ow ls) (s.P.length + i) = (ls.toShape[i]?).bind (·.1) := by
  simp only [parentOf, allocP_new h, Option.bind_some]

/-- The parent of a new place is an earlier new place (§71.1: well-formed shape). -/
theorem parentOf_ge {s : S3} {ow : Nat} {ls : LocalShape}
    (hsh : ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape) {q r : Nat} (hq : s.P.length ≤ q)
    (h : parentOf (allocP s ow ls) q = some r) : s.P.length ≤ r ∧ r < q := by
  have hlt : q < s.P.length + ls.length := by
    simp only [parentOf] at h
    cases h' : (allocP s ow ls)[q]? with
    | none => rw [h'] at h; cases h
    | some _ => have := lt_of_getElem? h'; rwa [allocP_len] at this
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ : ∃ i, q = s.P.length + i := ⟨q - s.P.length, by omega⟩
  rw [parentOf_new (by omega)] at h
  have h1 := (hsh i (List.mem_range.2 (by rw [length_toShape]; omega))).1
  rw [h] at h1
  simp only [OptP] at h1
  obtain ⟨h₁, h₂, -⟩ := h1
  exact ⟨h₁, h₂⟩

/-- The structural ancestors of a new place are new places (§71.1). -/
theorem chain_ge {s : S3} {ow : Nat} {ls : LocalShape} (hsh : ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape) :
    ∀ n q, q < n → s.P.length ≤ q → ∀ x ∈ chain (parentOf (allocP s ow ls)) q, s.P.length ≤ x
  | 0, _, h, _, _, _ => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | n + 1, q, hq, hge, x, hx => by
    cases hpo : parentOf (allocP s ow ls) q with
    | none => rw [chain_none hpo] at hx; simp at hx
    | some r =>
      obtain ⟨hr, hrq⟩ := parentOf_ge hsh hge hpo
      rw [chain_cons hpo hrq] at hx
      rcases List.mem_cons.1 hx with rfl | hx
      · exact hr
      · exact chain_ge hsh n r (by omega) hr x hx

/-- `alloc` keeps the structural ancestors of the former places (§71, `ok`). -/
theorem chain_old {s : S3} {ow : Nat} {ls : LocalShape} {l : Nat} (h : l < s.P.length) :
    chain (parentOf (allocP s ow ls)) l = chain (parentOf s.P) l :=
  chain_congr fun _ hj => parentOf_lt (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt hj h)

/-- `alloc` keeps the structural parts of the former places (§40, §71 `ok`). -/
theorem partOf_old {s : S3} {ow : Nat} {ls : LocalShape} {l r : Nat} (h : l < s.P.length) :
    partOf (allocP s ow ls) l r ↔ partOf s.P l r := by
  simp only [partOf, chain_old h, allocP_len]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨-, hc⟩; exact ⟨h, hc⟩
  · rintro ⟨-, hc⟩; exact ⟨by omega, hc⟩

/-- A former place is a leaf after `alloc` exactly when it was one before: new places have new
parents (§40, §71.1). -/
theorem isLeaf_old {s : S3} {ow : Nat} {ls : LocalShape} (hsh : ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape)
    {l : Nat} (h : l < s.P.length) : isLeaf (allocP s ow ls) l ↔ isLeaf s.P l := by
  constructor
  · intro hl r hr
    rw [← parentOf_lt (ow := ow) (ls := ls) hr]
    exact hl r (by rw [allocP_len]; omega)
  · intro hl r _ hp
    by_cases hrn : r < s.P.length
    · rw [parentOf_lt hrn] at hp; exact hl r hrn hp
    · have := (parentOf_ge hsh (by omega) hp).1; omega

/-- `alloc` keeps the footprints of the former places (§40, §71 `ok`). -/
theorem footprint_old {s : S3} {ow : Nat} {ls : LocalShape} (hsh : ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape)
    {q : Nat} (hq : q < s.P.length) (l : Nat) :
    l ∈ footprint (allocP s ow ls) q ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P q := by
  rw [mem_footprint, mem_footprint]
  by_cases hl : l < s.P.length
  · rw [isLeaf_old hsh hl, partOf_old hl]
    exact ⟨fun h => ⟨hl, h.2⟩, fun h => ⟨by rw [allocP_len]; omega, h.2⟩⟩
  · constructor
    · rintro ⟨-, -, -, hc | hc⟩
      · omega
      · have := chain_ge hsh (l + 1) l (Nat.lt_succ_self l) (by omega) q hc; omega
    · rintro ⟨h, -⟩; exact absurd h hl

/-- The leaves of the new place `|P|` are new places (§71, `ok`). -/
theorem fp_new_ge {s : S3} {ow : Nat} {ls : LocalShape} {l : Nat}
    (h : l ∈ footprint (allocP s ow ls) s.P.length) : s.P.length ≤ l := by
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, h | h⟩ := mem_footprint.1 h
  · omega
  · have := chain_lt h; omega

/-! ## The single new root (§71.1, §71 `ok`) -/

section Root
variable {k : K} {s : S3} {pr ow : Nat} {ls : LocalShape}

theorem allocEff_A (hst : AllocStatic k s pr ow ls) : (allocEff s ow ls).A =
    s.A ++ [⟨.modify, none, footprint (allocP s ow ls) s.P.length, .place ow, true⟩] := by
  simp only [allocEff, rootIdx_eq hst, List.map_cons, List.map_nil, Nat.add_zero,
    shapeOwner_toShape]

/-- An authority after `alloc` is a former one, or the new root authority at the fresh identity
`|A|` (§42 fresh identities, §71 `ok`). -/
theorem allocA_get (hst : AllocStatic k s pr ow ls) {j : Nat} {z : Authority}
    (h : (allocEff s ow ls).A[j]? = some z) :
    (j < s.A.length ∧ s.A[j]? = some z) ∨
    (j = s.A.length ∧
      z = ⟨.modify, none, footprint (allocP s ow ls) s.P.length, .place ow, true⟩) :=
  addAuth_get (s := s) (by show (s.A ++ [_])[j]? = some z; rw [← allocEff_A hst]; exact h)

/-- The new root authority has no origin, so `alloc` keeps every origin link (§42, §71 `ok`). -/
theorem org_eq (hst : AllocStatic k s pr ow ls) : (allocEff s ow ls).org = s.org := by
  funext i
  simp only [S3.org, allocEff_A hst]
  by_cases hi : i < s.A.length
  · rw [List.getElem?_append_left hi]
  · rw [List.getElem?_append_right (by omega), List.getElem?_eq_none (by omega : s.A.length ≤ i)]
    cases i - s.A.length <;> simp

/-- `alloc` keeps every origin chain (§42, §71 `ok`). -/
theorem ancs_eq (hst : AllocStatic k s pr ow ls) : (allocEff s ow ls).ancs = s.ancs := by
  funext x; simp only [S3.ancs, org_eq hst]

end Root

/-- `alloc` keeps the former authorities (§71, `ok`). -/
theorem A_lt {s : S3} {ow : Nat} {ls : LocalShape} {j : Nat} (h : j < s.A.length) :
    (allocEff s ow ls).A[j]? = s.A[j]? := List.getElem?_append_left h

/-! ## Usability and frames (§40, §44) -/

section Usable
variable {s : S3} {ow : Nat} {ls : LocalShape}

/-- A place usable before `alloc` stays usable (§40, §71 `ok`). -/
theorem usable_old {q : Nat} (h : s.Usable q) : (allocEff s ow ls).Usable q := by
  induction h with

import Ern.MemoryModel.Arena

/-!
# Handle pool: a library instance of the access discipline (non-normative)

**Non-normative.** This module formalizes the library contract "HandlePool v0.5": the HandlePool
v0.4 annex (items D.1–D.4) as amended by the arbitrations Q3, Q4, Q5 and Q12 (items HP5-1 to
HP5-7), by the second follow-up to Q3 and Q5 (HP5-1', HP5-1'') and by the decision on Q3 of
2026-11-06 (the metadata write of `freeSlot`, HP5-1).
`specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md` does not define it (Part XIV preamble: "The
contracts of `HandlePool` and `DataStack` belong to their library abstractions and are not defined
here"). The normative clauses that constrain it are §36 (`MetaRight` is exercisable `Modify` on the
administering value; `writeShared` alone is insufficient; the library adds no rights to the
kernel), §37 and §89 (handles are data, not authorities; a stale identity or generation leads to
defined failure), §38 and §46 (library state outside `S₃`), §47 (empty initial registry), §56 (the
guard over all registries of live administrations), §58 (outcomes) and §76 (the obligations of
`newArena` that `newPool` takes over).

The pool registry lives beside the kernel state (`PState`). Its operations are built on the
kernel operations O1–O16 (§60–§75): `newPool` registers only; `allocSlot` writes the handle into
its destination (O10); `resolve` derives a companion from `internal` over the whole storage, then
an entry authority from the companion (O1 twice); `resolveMany` does the same with `split` (O2) in
`Modify` and with one `Observe` derive per handle (O1) in `Observe`; `unresolve` releases (O3);
`freeSlot` writes its metadata leaves, the leaves of the pool value (O10), then updates the
registry (HP5-1, Q3 decision of 2026-11-06). Every library step is thus, on the kernel side, a
finite sequence of accepted kernel steps (`pstep_kernel`), so, under `DDSound` (§80) and
`StaticsOK` (§47), every kernel state of a library run is kernel-reachable and satisfies the
invariant of §57 (`kernel_guarantee`, HP5-7).
-/

namespace Ern.Lib.HandlePool

open Ern.MemoryModel
open Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! ## Library state (HandlePool v0.5, D.1; §38, §46) -/

/-- Slot of a pool entry (HandlePool v0.5, D.1: `{place, gen : Nat, live : Bool}`; non-normative
library contract; §38, §46). -/
structure Slot where
  place : Nat
  gen : Nat
  live : Bool
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Pool entry `{storage, internal, slots}` with its logical identity (HandlePool v0.5, D.1;
non-normative library contract). The pool value is the place holding `internal` (§46 analogue). -/
structure Pool where
  id : Nat
  storage : Nat
  internal : Nat
  slots : List Slot
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Handle `(poolId, slot, gen)`: data, not an authority (HandlePool v0.5, D.1; §37, §89;
non-normative library contract). -/
structure Handle where
  id : Nat
  slot : Nat
  gen : Nat
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Ghost record of a resolution (HandlePool v0.5, D.2; auxiliary information creating no right,
§38): pool identity and `internal`, the companion, the mode, and the entry authorities tagged with
their slot and resolved generation. Read by `unresolve` and by the invariants. -/
structure Res where
  pool : Nat
  internal : Nat
  comp : Nat
  mode : Mode
  entries : List (Nat × Nat × Nat)
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Library state (§38, §46; HandlePool v0.5, D.1; non-normative library contract): the kernel
state `S₃` and, separately, the pool registry, the next fresh pool identity and the ghost
resolutions. -/
structure PState where
  kern : S3
  pools : List Pool
  nId : Nat
  res : List Res

/-- Initial library state (§47; HandlePool v0.5, D.1): the initial kernel state, an empty
registry. -/
def PState.init (statics : Statics) : PState := ⟨S3.init statics, [], 0, []⟩

/-- The pool read as an arena entry with nothing available or issued, to reuse `MetaRight` of §36
(HandlePool v0.5, D.3; non-normative library contract). -/
def Pool.entry (pl : Pool) : Arena.ArenaEntry := ⟨pl.storage, pl.internal, [], []⟩

/-- Administration right on the pool (§36; HandlePool v0.5, D.3 corrected by §36, HP5-1;
non-normative library contract): the pool is live (`internal` active) and `MetaRight` holds,
exercisable `Modify` over the pool value; no `writeShared` branch. -/
def AdminRight (s : S3) (pl : Pool) : Prop := s.Active pl.internal ∧ Arena.MetaRight s pl.entry

/-- Decidability of `AdminRight` (§36; HandlePool v0.5, D.3). -/
instance (s : S3) (pl : Pool) : Decidable (AdminRight s pl) := by
  unfold AdminRight; infer_instance

/-- Place of slot `i`, `0` if absent (HandlePool v0.5, D.1; non-normative library contract;
§46). -/
def slotPlace (pl : Pool) (i : Nat) : Nat := ((pl.slots[i]?).map (·.place)).getD 0

/-- The pool with slot `i` replaced (HandlePool v0.5, D.3; non-normative library contract;
§46). -/
def setSlot (pl : Pool) (i : Nat) (sl : Slot) : Pool := { pl with slots := pl.slots.set i sl }

/-! ## `newPool` (HandlePool v0.5, D.1; §56, §76) -/

/-- The pool registry as a registry of live administrations (§56; HandlePool v0.5, D.1;

/-! ## `freeSlot` (HandlePool v0.5, D.3 as amended by HP5-1, HP5-1', HP5-1'') -/

/-- No active strict descendant of the `internal` of pool `pl` covers a leaf of place `q`
(HandlePool v0.5, HP5-1 as amended by HP5-1': "aucune autorité active, descendante stricte de
internal de ce pool, ne couvre l'entrée"; §42: descendants along the current origin chain, which
covers the reanchoring of §73.4 onto `internal`; non-normative library contract). -/
def NoInternalDesc (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (q : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ x ∈ List.range s.A.length, s.Active x → pl.internal ∈ s.ancs x →
    ∀ l ∈ s.afp x, l ∉ footprint s.P q

/-- Decidability of `NoInternalDesc` (HandlePool v0.5, HP5-1'; §42). -/
instance (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (q : Nat) : Decidable (NoInternalDesc s pl q) := by
  unfold NoInternalDesc; infer_instance

/-- Content conditions of `freeSlot` on slot place `q` of pool `pl` (HandlePool v0.5, HP5-1,
HP5-1'; non-normative library contract; §41, §42). -/
structure FreeContentOK (L : PState) (pl : Pool) (q : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- HandlePool v0.5, HP5-1: no leaf of the entry is `Init`; each is `Uninit` or `Moved`
  (§41). -/
  notInit : ∀ l ∈ footprint L.kern.P q, L.kern.I l ≠ .init
  /-- HandlePool v0.5, HP5-1': no active strict descendant of `internal` of this pool covers a
  leaf of the entry (§42). -/
  noDesc : NoInternalDesc L.kern pl q

/-- Decidability of `FreeContentOK` (HandlePool v0.5, HP5-1, HP5-1'; §41, §42). -/
instance (L : PState) (pl : Pool) (q : Nat) : Decidable (FreeContentOK L pl q) :=
  decidable_of_iff ((∀ l ∈ footprint L.kern.P q, L.kern.I l ≠ .init) ∧ NoInternalDesc L.kern pl q)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩, fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩⟩

/-- Metadata leaves of pool `pl` (HandlePool v0.5, HP5-1 as amended by arbitration Q3, decision
of 2026-11-06; non-normative library contract; §46 analogue, §36): the leaves (§40) of the pool
value, the place holding `internal` (`Arena.arenaValue`); empty when `internal` is absent or held
by a frame, a case `AdminRight` excludes. The decision does not name the metadata leaves: taking all
the leaves of the pool value is the reading of this formalization, on the basis of §36 (`MetaRight`
is exercisable `Modify` on the administering value) and HP5-3 (the write of the pool value). -/
def metaLeaves (s : S3) (pl : Pool) : List Nat :=
  match Arena.arenaValue s pl.entry with
  | some v => footprint s.P v
  | none => []

/-- The metadata leaves are the leaves of the pool value (HandlePool v0.5, HP5-1, Q3 decision of
2026-11-06; §46 analogue, §40). -/
theorem metaLeaves_of {s : S3} {pl : Pool} {v : Nat} (h : Arena.arenaValue s pl.entry = some v) :
    metaLeaves s pl = footprint s.P v := by
  unfold metaLeaves; rw [h]

/-- Effect of `freeSlot` on slot `i` of pool `j` (HandlePool v0.5, HP5-1 as amended by arbitration
Q3, decision of 2026-11-06; non-normative library contract): the kernel write of the metadata
leaves (§67 effect: they become `Init`), then the abstract update: the slot becomes free and its
generation is incremented. There is no end-of-use effect, and the library adds no rights to the
kernel (§36). -/
def freeSlotEff (L : PState) (j : Nat) (pl : Pool) (i : Nat) (sl : Slot) : PState :=
  { L with
    kern := write3Eff L.kern (metaLeaves L.kern pl)
    pools := L.pools.set j (setSlot pl i ⟨sl.place, sl.gen + 1, false⟩) }

/-- `freeSlot(h)` on pool `j` as a relation (HandlePool v0.5, D.3 corrected by §36, HP5-1; outcome
order of HP5-1'' (Q5 extended to `freeSlot`); §58, §89; non-normative library contract): `reject`
without the pool; then `fail` for a handle of a dead pool, of another pool, stale, absent or free,
before the right is checked; then `reject` without the administration right (live pool and
`MetaRight`); then `reject` unless the content conditions hold (`FreeContentOK`); then `ok`, whose
effect is `freeSlotEff` (the write of the metadata leaves, Q3 decision of 2026-11-06). As for
`allocSlot`, the preconditions of that kernel write (§67) are not fields of the step: they follow
from `AdminRight` under `KInv` (`meta_write_of_kinv`). -/
inductive FreeSlotStep (j : Nat) (h : Handle) (L : PState) : Outcome3 PState → Prop where
  | noPool : L.pools[j]? = none → FreeSlotStep j h L .reject
  | fail {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → ¬ HandleOK L.kern pl h → FreeSlotStep j h L .fail
  | noRight {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → HandleOK L.kern pl h → ¬ AdminRight L.kern pl →
      FreeSlotStep j h L .reject
  | noContent {pl : Pool} {sl : Slot} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → HandleOK L.kern pl h →
      AdminRight L.kern pl → pl.slots[h.slot]? = some sl → ¬ FreeContentOK L pl sl.place →
      FreeSlotStep j h L .reject
  | ok {pl : Pool} {sl : Slot} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → HandleOK L.kern pl h →
      AdminRight L.kern pl → pl.slots[h.slot]? = some sl → FreeContentOK L pl sl.place →
      FreeSlotStep j h L (.ok (freeSlotEff L j pl h.slot sl))

/-! ## Library runs (HandlePool v0.5; §38, §46, §47) -/

/-- One `ok` step of a library run (HandlePool v0.5; non-normative library contract): a kernel
step O1–O16 of non-administrative code, the registry unchanged, or an accepted pool operation
(§58). -/
inductive PStep (k : K) : PState → PState → Prop where
  | kernel {L : PState} {s' : S3} : KStep k L.kern s' → PStep k L { L with kern := s' }
  | newPool {L L' : PState} {others : List (List Nat)} {st i : Nat} :
      NewPoolStep others st i L (.ok L') → PStep k L L'
  | allocSlot {L L' : PState} {j dst : Nat} : AllocSlotStep j dst L (.ok L') → PStep k L L'
  | resolve {L L' : PState} {j : Nat} {h : Handle} {m : Mode} :
      ResolveStep j h m L (.ok L') → PStep k L L'
  | resolveMany {L L' : PState} {j : Nat} {hs : List Handle} {m : Mode} :
      ResolveManyStep k j hs m L (.ok L') → PStep k L L'
  | unresolve {L L' : PState} {c : Nat} : UnresolveStep c L (.ok L') → PStep k L L'
  | freeSlot {L L' : PState} {j : Nat} {h : Handle} : FreeSlotStep j h L (.ok L') →
      PStep k L L'

/-- Library states reachable from the initial library state (§47) by library steps
(HandlePool v0.5; non-normative library contract). -/
inductive PReach (k : K) (statics : Statics) : PState → Prop where
  | init : PReach k statics (PState.init statics)
  | step {L L' : PState} : PReach k statics L → PStep k L L' → PReach k statics L'

/-! ## Kernel side of the pool operations (§57, §58; HandlePool v0.5, HP5-7) -/

/-- Finite sequences of kernel steps O1–O16 (§57, §58; HandlePool v0.5, HP5-7). -/
inductive KSeq (k : K) : S3 → S3 → Prop where
  | refl (s : S3) : KSeq k s s
  | tail {s s₁ s₂ : S3} : KSeq k s s₁ → KStep k s₁ s₂ → KSeq k s s₂

    cases hs with
    | ok _ _ hR _ _ =>
      obtain ⟨-, a, -, -, -, hw⟩ := meta_write_of_kinv hk hR
      exact KSeq.single (.write (a := a) (Guarded.ok hw))

/-- The kernel state of every library-reachable state is reachable from `S3.init statics` by
kernel steps O1–O16 (§57; HandlePool v0.5, HP5-7), under `DDSound` (§80) and `StaticsOK` (§47),
which give `KInv` on the kernel side of the run (`Access.reachable_kinv`). -/
theorem pReach_reachable {k : K} {statics : Statics} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    {L : PState} (h : PReach k statics L) : Reachable k statics L.kern := by
  induction h with
  | init => exact .init
  | step _ hs ih => exact (pstep_kernel (reachable_kinv hdd hst ih) hs).reachable ih

/-- The guarantee of §57 on the kernel side of library runs (HandlePool v0.5, HP5-7, O5.g;
non-normative library contract): every kernel state of a library-reachable state satisfies
`KInv`. -/
def KernelGuarantee (k : K) (statics : Statics) : Prop := ∀ L, PReach k statics L → KInv L.kern

/-- `KernelGuarantee` holds under `DDSound` (§80) and `StaticsOK` (§47) (HandlePool v0.5, HP5-7;
§57): the kernel state of a library-reachable state is kernel-reachable (`pReach_reachable`). -/
theorem kernel_guarantee {k : K} {statics : Statics} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics) :
    KernelGuarantee k statics :=
  fun _ h => reachable_kinv hdd hst (pReach_reachable hdd hst h)

/-! ## Helper lemmas (lists, chains, effects) -/

/-! ## Ghost well-formedness of the pool layer (HandlePool v0.5, D.1, D.2; auxiliary) -/

/-- What `allocSlot` and `freeSlot` keep of a pool: identity, storage, `internal` and slot places
(HandlePool v0.5, D.1, D.3; auxiliary information, §38). -/
structure PoolShape where
  id : Nat
  storage : Nat
  internal : Nat
  places : List Nat

/-- The shape of a pool (HandlePool v0.5, D.1; auxiliary; §38). -/
def Pool.shape (pl : Pool) : PoolShape := ⟨pl.id, pl.storage, pl.internal, pl.slots.map (·.place)⟩

/-- Updating a slot with the same place keeps the shape (HandlePool v0.5, D.3; §38). -/
theorem setSlot_shape {pl : Pool} {i : Nat} {sl x : Slot} (hs : pl.slots[i]? = some sl)
    (hx : x.place = sl.place) : (setSlot pl i x).shape = pl.shape := by
  simp only [Pool.shape, setSlot, map_set_same (·.place) hs hx]

/-- Well-formedness of a pool shape (auxiliary, not a clause of the contract; HandlePool v0.5, D.1,
from `newPool`): `internal` is a `Modify` authority whose footprint is the footprint of the storage
(§76.2, §76.3); the storage and every slot have a leaf; slots lie in the storage and are pairwise
disjoint (D.1). -/
structure PoolOK (s : S3) (sh : PoolShape) : Prop where
  /-- §76.2: `internal` exists, with own mode `Modify` (HandlePool v0.5, D.1). -/
  internalMode : OptP (s.A[sh.internal]?) (fun y => y.mode = .modify) False
  /-- §76.3: `footprint(internal) = footprint(storage)` (HandlePool v0.5, D.1). -/
  fpEq : ∀ l, l ∈ s.afp sh.internal ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P sh.storage
  /-- §40, §49.2: the storage has a leaf (HandlePool v0.5, D.1). -/
  storageLeaf : ∃ l, l ∈ footprint s.P sh.storage
  /-- §40, §49.2: every slot has a leaf (HandlePool v0.5, D.1). -/
  slotLeaf : ∀ q ∈ sh.places, ∃ l, l ∈ footprint s.P q
  /-- HandlePool v0.5, D.1: slots lie in the storage. -/
  slotIn : ∀ q ∈ sh.places, ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, l ∈ footprint s.P sh.storage
  /-- HandlePool v0.5, D.1: slots are pairwise disjoint. -/
  disjoint : ∀ (a b qa qb : Nat), sh.places[a]? = some qa → sh.places[b]? = some qb → a ≠ b →
    ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P qa, l ∉ footprint s.P qb

/-- Well-formedness of a ghost resolution (auxiliary, HandlePool v0.5, D.2): it belongs to a pool
of `shs` with its `internal`; the companion is younger than `internal`, of the mode of the
resolution, over the footprint of the storage; each entry authority is younger than the companion,
over the footprint of its slot (§38, §60). -/
def ResOK (s : S3) (shs : List PoolShape) (r : Res) : Prop :=
  ∃ sh ∈ shs, sh.id = r.pool ∧ sh.internal = r.internal ∧ r.internal < r.comp ∧
    OptP (s.A[r.comp]?) (fun y => y.mode = r.mode ∧
      ∀ l, l ∈ y.footprint ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P sh.storage) False ∧
    ∀ e ∈ r.entries, r.comp < e.1 ∧ ∃ q, sh.places[e.2.1]? = some q ∧
      OptP (s.A[e.1]?) (fun y => ∀ l, l ∈ y.footprint ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P q) False

/-- Ghost well-formedness of the pool layer (auxiliary, not a clause of the contract;
HandlePool v0.5, D.1, D.2): fresh distinct identities, well-formed pools and resolutions (§38). -/
structure PoolWF (L : PState) : Prop where
  /-- HandlePool v0.5, D.1: identities are below the next fresh identity. -/
  ids : ∀ sh ∈ L.pools.map Pool.shape, sh.id < L.nId
  /-- HandlePool v0.5, D.1: identities are distinct. -/
  nodup : ((L.pools.map Pool.shape).map (·.id)).Nodup
  /-- HandlePool v0.5, D.1: every pool is well formed. -/
  pools : ∀ sh ∈ L.pools.map Pool.shape, PoolOK L.kern sh
  /-- HandlePool v0.5, D.2: every ghost resolution is well formed. -/
  res : ∀ r ∈ L.res, ResOK L.kern (L.pools.map Pool.shape) r

/-- Exclusivity of the companions of a pool (HandlePool v0.5, D.2 restricted to the companions of
the pool, HP5-4; non-normative library contract): two distinct active companions of the same pool
are both `Observe` (§43, §50). -/
def CompExcl (L : PState) : Prop :=
  ∀ r₁ ∈ L.res, ∀ r₂ ∈ L.res, r₁.pool = r₂.pool → r₁.comp ≠ r₂.comp →
    L.kern.Active r₁.comp → L.kern.Active r₂.comp → r₁.mode = .observe ∧ r₂.mode = .observe

/-- Footprints of every place with a leaf are kept (§40; support for HandlePool v0.5, D.1). -/
def FpKeep (s s' : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ q l₀, l₀ ∈ footprint s.P q → ∀ l, l ∈ footprint s'.P q ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P q

/-- Same places keep footprints (§40; support for HandlePool v0.5, D.1). -/
theorem fpKeep_of_P {s s' : S3} (h : s'.P = s.P) : FpKeep s s' := fun _ _ _ _ => by rw [h]

/-- Kernel steps keep footprints (§40; §60–§75 effects; support for HandlePool v0.5, D.1). -/
theorem fpKeep_kstep {k : K} {s s' : S3} (h : KStep k s s') : FpKeep s s' :=
  fun _ _ h₀ l => Arena.kstep_fp h (Arena.footprint_lt h₀) l

/-- `FpKeep` composes (§40; support for HandlePool v0.5, D.1). -/
theorem FpKeep.trans {s s₁ s₂ : S3} (h₁ : FpKeep s s₁) (h₂ : FpKeep s₁ s₂) : FpKeep s s₂ :=
  fun q l₀ h₀ l => (h₂ q l₀ ((h₁ q l₀ h₀ l₀).2 h₀) l).trans (h₁ q l₀ h₀ l)

/-- A sequence of kernel steps keeps the authorities and the footprints (§42, §58; §60–§75;
HandlePool v0.5). -/
theorem KSeq.keep {k : K} {s s' : S3} (h : KSeq k s s') : Arena.AKeep s s' ∧ FpKeep s s' := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact ⟨Arena.akeep_of_eq rfl, fpKeep_of_P rfl⟩
  | tail _ hs ih => exact ⟨ih.1.trans (Arena.kstep_akeep hs), ih.2.trans (fpKeep_kstep hs)⟩

/-- `PoolOK` carries over to a state keeping authorities and footprints (§42, §40;
HandlePool v0.5, D.1). -/
theorem PoolOK.transport {s s' : S3} {sh : PoolShape} (h : PoolOK s sh) (hA : Arena.AKeep s s')
    (hf : FpKeep s s') : PoolOK s' sh := by
  obtain ⟨hm, hfp, ⟨l₀, hl₀⟩, hsl, hin, hd⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hym⟩ := optP_false_iff.1 hm
  obtain ⟨y', hy', m', f', -⟩ := hA _ y hy
  have hst := hf sh.storage l₀ hl₀
  have hq : ∀ q ∈ sh.places, ∀ l, l ∈ footprint s'.P q ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P q := fun q hq' => by
    obtain ⟨l₁, hl₁⟩ := hsl q hq'; exact hf q l₁ hl₁
  have hafp : s'.afp sh.internal = s.afp sh.internal := by simp [S3.afp, hy, hy', f']
  refine ⟨optP_false_iff.2 ⟨y', hy', m'.trans hym⟩, fun l => ?_, ⟨l₀, (hst l₀).2 hl₀⟩,
    fun q hq' => ?_, fun q hq' l hl => ?_, fun a b qa qb ha hb hab l hla hlb => ?_⟩
  · rw [hafp, hst]; exact hfp l
  · obtain ⟨l₁, hl₁⟩ := hsl q hq'; exact ⟨l₁, (hq q hq' l₁).2 hl₁⟩
  · exact (hst l).2 (hin q hq' l ((hq q hq' l).1 hl))
  · exact hd a b qa qb ha hb hab l ((hq qa (List.mem_of_getElem? ha) l).1 hla)
      ((hq qb (List.mem_of_getElem? hb) l).1 hlb)

/-- `ResOK` carries over to a state keeping authorities and footprints and to a larger list of
shapes (HandlePool v0.5, D.2; §42). -/
theorem ResOK.transport {s s' : S3} {shs shs' : List PoolShape} {r : Res} (h : ResOK s shs r)
    (hA : Arena.AKeep s s') (hf : FpKeep s s') (hok : ∀ sh ∈ shs, PoolOK s sh)
    (hsub : ∀ sh ∈ shs, sh ∈ shs') : ResOK s' shs' r := by
  obtain ⟨sh, hsh, hid, hint, hlt, hc, he⟩ := h
  have hok' := hok sh hsh
  obtain ⟨l₀, hl₀⟩ := hok'.storageLeaf
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hm, hfp⟩ := optP_false_iff.1 hc
  obtain ⟨y', hy', m', f', -⟩ := hA _ y hy
  refine ⟨sh, hsub sh hsh, hid, hint, hlt, optP_false_iff.2 ⟨y', hy', m'.trans hm, fun l => ?_⟩,
    fun e he' => ?_⟩
  · rw [f', hf _ l₀ hl₀ l]; exact hfp l
  · obtain ⟨hlt', q, hq, ho⟩ := he e he'
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hzf⟩ := optP_false_iff.1 ho
    obtain ⟨z', hz', -, zf', -⟩ := hA _ z hz
    obtain ⟨l₁, hl₁⟩ := hok'.slotLeaf q (List.mem_of_getElem? hq)
    exact ⟨hlt', q, hq,
      optP_false_iff.2 ⟨z', hz', fun l => by rw [zf', hf q l₁ hl₁ l]; exact hzf l⟩⟩

/-- `PoolWF` carries over to a state keeping authorities and footprints, with pools of the same
shapes (HandlePool v0.5, D.1, D.2, D.3; §42). -/
theorem PoolWF.transport {L : PState} {s' : S3} {pools' : List Pool} (h : PoolWF L)
    (hA : Arena.AKeep L.kern s') (hf : FpKeep L.kern s')
    (hsh : pools'.map Pool.shape = L.pools.map Pool.shape) :
    PoolWF ⟨s', pools', L.nId, L.res⟩ := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, fun r hr => ?_⟩
  · show ∀ sh ∈ pools'.map Pool.shape, sh.id < L.nId
    rw [hsh]; exact h.ids
  · show ((pools'.map Pool.shape).map (·.id)).Nodup
    rw [hsh]; exact h.nodup
  · show ∀ sh ∈ pools'.map Pool.shape, PoolOK s' sh
    rw [hsh]; exact fun sh hs => (h.pools sh hs).transport hA hf
  · show ResOK s' (pools'.map Pool.shape) r
    rw [hsh]; exact (h.res r hr).transport hA hf h.pools fun _ h => h

/-- A companion of a ghost resolution exists (HandlePool v0.5, D.2; §42). -/
theorem comp_lt {L : PState} (hw : PoolWF L) {r : Res} (hr : r ∈ L.res) :
    r.comp < L.kern.A.length := by
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, hc, _⟩ := hw.res r hr
  obtain ⟨y, hy, -⟩ := optP_false_iff.1 hc
  exact lt_of_getElem? hy

/-- `CompExcl` carries over to a kernel state that reactivates nothing (HandlePool v0.5, D.2;
§42). -/
theorem CompExcl.kern {L : PState} {s' : S3} (h : CompExcl L) (hw : PoolWF L)
    (hA : Arena.AKeep L.kern s') : CompExcl { L with kern := s' } :=
  fun r₁ hr₁ r₂ hr₂ hp hne ha₁ ha₂ => h r₁ hr₁ r₂ hr₂ hp hne
    (hA.active_back ha₁ (comp_lt hw hr₁)) (hA.active_back ha₂ (comp_lt hw hr₂))

/-- Two shapes of a list with distinct identities and the same identity are equal
(HandlePool v0.5, D.1; §46). -/
theorem eq_of_id : ∀ {l : List PoolShape} {a b : PoolShape}, (l.map (·.id)).Nodup → a ∈ l →
    b ∈ l → a.id = b.id → a = b
  | [], _, _, _, ha, _, _ => by simp at ha
  | c :: l, a, b, hn, ha, hb, he => by
    rw [List.map_cons, List.nodup_cons] at hn
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 ha with ha' | ha' <;> rcases List.mem_cons.1 hb with hb' | hb'
    · rw [ha', hb']
    · subst ha'; exact absurd (he ▸ List.mem_map_of_mem (f := (·.id)) hb') hn.1
    · subst hb'; exact absurd (he.symm ▸ List.mem_map_of_mem (f := (·.id)) ha') hn.1
    · exact eq_of_id hn.2 ha' hb' he

      OptP (L.kern.A[r.comp]?) (fun y => y.mode = r.mode ∧
        ∀ l, l ∈ y.footprint ↔ l ∈ footprint L.kern.P pl.storage) False := by

theorem pReach_poolWF {k : K} {statics : Statics} {L : PState} (h : PReach k statics L) :

theorem pReach_compExcl {k : K} {statics : Statics} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
