/-- The effect of an accepted `freeSlot` (HandlePool v0.5, HP5-1 as amended by arbitration Q3,
decision of 2026-11-06): the pool exists with the administration right, the handle is valid, and
the content conditions hold; the arrival state is `freeSlotEff`, whose kernel state is the write of
the metadata leaves (§67 effect), whose resolutions are those of the departure state (no
end-of-use effect; §36, §58), and whose slot is free with its generation incremented. -/
theorem freeSlot_effect {L L' : PState} {j : Nat} {h : Handle}
    (hst : FreeSlotStep j h L (.ok L')) :
    ∃ pl sl, L.pools[j]? = some pl ∧ pl.slots[h.slot]? = some sl ∧ AdminRight L.kern pl ∧
      HandleOK L.kern pl h ∧ FreeContentOK L pl sl.place ∧ L' = freeSlotEff L j pl h.slot sl ∧
      L'.kern = write3Eff L.kern (metaLeaves L.kern pl) ∧ L'.res = L.res ∧
      L'.pools[j]? = some (setSlot pl h.slot ⟨sl.place, sl.gen + 1, false⟩) := by
  cases hst with
  | @ok pl sl hp hH hR hsl hc =>
    exact ⟨pl, sl, hp, hsl, hR, hH, hc, rfl, rfl, rfl, getElem?_set_eq' hp⟩

/-- After an accepted `freeSlot(h)`, the freed slot is free with generation `h.gen + 1`, and `h` is
stale: `resolve` of `h`, and `resolveMany` of any batch containing `h`, fail (HandlePool v0.5,
HP5-6; §89). -/
theorem pool_freeSlot_then_stale {k : K} {L L' : PState} {j : Nat} {h : Handle}
    (hst : FreeSlotStep j h L (.ok L')) :
    (∃ pl' sl', L'.pools[j]? = some pl' ∧ pl'.slots[h.slot]? = some sl' ∧ sl'.live = false ∧
      sl'.gen = h.gen + 1) ∧
    (∀ m o, ResolveStep j h m L' o → o = .fail) ∧
    (∀ hs m o, h ∈ hs → ResolveManyStep k j hs m L' o → o = .fail) := by
  cases hst with
  | @ok pl sl hp hH _ hsl _ =>
    have hp' := getElem?_set_eq' (x := setSlot pl h.slot ⟨sl.place, sl.gen + 1, false⟩) hp
    have hs' := getElem?_set_eq' (x := (⟨sl.place, sl.gen + 1, false⟩ : Slot)) hsl
    have hn : ¬ HandleOK (freeSlotEff L j pl h.slot sl).kern
        (setSlot pl h.slot ⟨sl.place, sl.gen + 1, false⟩) h := not_handleOK_free hs' rfl
    obtain ⟨-, -, ho⟩ := hH
    rw [hsl] at ho
    exact ⟨⟨_, _, hp', hs', rfl, by rw [ho.1]⟩, fun m => (pool_resolve_invalid_fails hp' hn).2,
      fun hs m o hh => (pool_resolveMany_invalid_fails hp' fun hB => hn (hB.1 h hh)).2 o⟩

/-- A write that sets only `Init` leaves is the identity on the kernel state (§67 effect, §41). -/
theorem write3Eff_of_init {s : S3} {ls : List Nat} (h : ∀ l ∈ ls, s.I l = .init) :
    write3Eff s ls = s := by
  have e : (fun p => if p ∈ ls then InitSt.init else s.I p) = s.I :=
    funext fun p => by
      by_cases hp : p ∈ ls
      · simp only [hp, ↓reduceIte]; exact (h p hp).symm
      · simp only [hp, ↓reduceIte]
  unfold write3Eff; rw [e]

/-- HandlePool v0.5, HP5-3 (mandatory proof (2) of arbitration Q3): the metadata update of
`freeSlot` (free state, generation) is realizable by an authorized write under the administration
right. On every library-reachable state, under `DDSound` (§80) and `StaticsOK` (§47), for every
pool with `AdminRight` (§36), the pool value `v` (the place holding `internal`) exists and the
kernel `write` (§67) of the leaves of `v` through the authority grounding `MetaRight` is accepted;
when the leaves of `v` are `Init`, its effect is the identity on the kernel state. Since the Q3
decision of 2026-11-06 this write is the kernel part of an accepted `freeSlot` (`freeSlotEff`,
`freeSlot_meta_leaves`). §76.5 requires `Init` leaves only when the pool is created: on a
library-reachable state with `AdminRight`, a leaf of `v` can be `Moved`, and the write of an
accepted `freeSlot` then makes it `Init` (`Witness.meta_write_not_identity`,
`freeSlot_kernel_write`). -/
theorem freeSlot_meta_write {k : K} {statics : Statics} (hdd : DDSound k)
    (hst : StaticsOK statics) {L : PState} (hr : PReach k statics L) {pl : Pool}
    (hR : AdminRight L.kern pl) :
    ∃ v a, Arena.arenaValue L.kern pl.entry = some v ∧
      Write3Step a (footprint L.kern.P v) L.kern (.ok (write3Eff L.kern (footprint L.kern.P v))) ∧
      ((∀ l ∈ footprint L.kern.P v, L.kern.I l = .init) →
        write3Eff L.kern (footprint L.kern.P v) = L.kern) := by
  have hk := kernel_guarantee hdd hst L hr
  obtain ⟨⟨y, hy, ya⟩, hm⟩ := hR
  unfold Arena.MetaRight at hm
  cases hv : Arena.arenaValue L.kern pl.entry with
  | none => rw [hv] at hm; exact (hm : False).elim
  | some v =>
    rw [hv] at hm
    obtain ⟨a, -, hex, hall⟩ : HasRight L.kern .modify v := hm
    have hhold : y.holder = .place v := by
      simp only [Arena.arenaValue, Pool.entry, hy] at hv
      revert hv; cases y.holder <;> simp
    have hu : L.kern.Usable v := by
      have := hk.1.holders _ y hy ya; rw [hhold] at this; exact this
    exact ⟨v, a, rfl, Guarded.ok (write_of_right hk hu hex hall fun _ h => h), write3Eff_of_init⟩

/-- HandlePool v0.5, HP5-1 as amended by arbitration Q3 (decision of 2026-11-06), proof (a): on
every library-reachable state, under `DDSound` (§80) and `StaticsOK` (§47), an accepted `freeSlot`
identifies its metadata leaves exactly: `internal` is held by the pool value `v` (§46 analogue), the
metadata leaves are the leaves of `v` (§40), and the kernel part of the step is the ordinary write
(§67) of those leaves through an authority `a` on which `MetaRight` rests, exercisable `Modify`
with effective `Modify` over every leaf of `v` (`Grounds`; §36, §43). -/
theorem freeSlot_meta_leaves {k : K} {statics : Statics} (hdd : DDSound k)
    (hst : StaticsOK statics) {L L' : PState} (hr : PReach k statics L) {j : Nat} {h : Handle}
    (hs : FreeSlotStep j h L (.ok L')) :
    ∃ pl v a, L.pools[j]? = some pl ∧ Arena.arenaValue L.kern pl.entry = some v ∧
      metaLeaves L.kern pl = footprint L.kern.P v ∧ Grounds L.kern .modify v a ∧
      Write3Step a (metaLeaves L.kern pl) L.kern (.ok L'.kern) := by
  cases hs with
  | @ok pl _ hp _ hR _ _ =>
    obtain ⟨v, a, hv, hml, hg, hw⟩ := meta_write_of_kinv (kernel_guarantee hdd hst L hr) hR
    exact ⟨pl, v, a, hp, hv, hml, hg, Guarded.ok hw⟩

/-- HandlePool v0.5, HP5-1 as amended by arbitration Q3 (decision of 2026-11-06), proof (b): the
kernel state after an accepted `freeSlot` is exactly the effect of the write of the metadata leaves,
the leaves of the pool value `v` (§67 effect): every metadata leaf is `Init`, with no hypothesis on
its state before (`Moved` included, §41, §59), every other leaf keeps its state, and the other
kernel components are unchanged (§38, §58). -/
theorem freeSlot_kernel_write {L L' : PState} {j : Nat} {h : Handle}
    (hs : FreeSlotStep j h L (.ok L')) :
    ∃ pl v, L.pools[j]? = some pl ∧ Arena.arenaValue L.kern pl.entry = some v ∧
      metaLeaves L.kern pl = footprint L.kern.P v ∧
      L'.kern = write3Eff L.kern (metaLeaves L.kern pl) ∧
      (∀ l ∈ metaLeaves L.kern pl, L'.kern.I l = .init) ∧
      (∀ l, l ∉ metaLeaves L.kern pl → L'.kern.I l = L.kern.I l) ∧
      L'.kern.F = L.kern.F ∧ L'.kern.nF = L.kern.nF ∧ L'.kern.P = L.kern.P ∧
      L'.kern.A = L.kern.A ∧ L'.kern.D = L.kern.D ∧ L'.kern.dead = L.kern.dead ∧
      L'.kern.pins = L.kern.pins := by
  cases hs with
  | @ok pl _ hp _ hR _ _ =>
    obtain ⟨v, hv, -⟩ := optP_false_iff.1 hR.2
    refine ⟨pl, v, hp, hv, metaLeaves_of hv, rfl, fun l hl => ?_, fun l hl => ?_, rfl, rfl, rfl,
      rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
    · show (write3Eff L.kern (metaLeaves L.kern pl)).I l = .init; simp [write3Eff, hl]
    · show (write3Eff L.kern (metaLeaves L.kern pl)).I l = L.kern.I l; simp [write3Eff, hl]

/-- HandlePool v0.5, HP5-1 as amended by arbitration Q3 (decision of 2026-11-06), proof (c): the
abstract update of an accepted `freeSlot` frees the slot with its generation incremented; the
identity, storage, `internal` and other slots of the pool, the other pools, the resolutions and the
next pool identity are unchanged; no memory right is added (`A` and `D` unchanged; §36: the library
adds no rights to the kernel); the metadata leaves of the updated pool are the written leaves, all
`Init` (§46 analogue, §67). The correspondence of (c) holds at the level of the written leaves and
of their initialization state only: `S3` has no value component (§38), so the values written (free
state, generation) cannot be stated. -/
theorem freeSlot_abstract_update {L L' : PState} {j : Nat} {h : Handle}
    (hs : FreeSlotStep j h L (.ok L')) :
    ∃ pl sl pl', L.pools[j]? = some pl ∧ pl.slots[h.slot]? = some sl ∧
      pl' = setSlot pl h.slot ⟨sl.place, sl.gen + 1, false⟩ ∧ L'.pools[j]? = some pl' ∧
      pl'.slots[h.slot]? = some ⟨sl.place, sl.gen + 1, false⟩ ∧
      (∀ i, i ≠ h.slot → pl'.slots[i]? = pl.slots[i]?) ∧
      pl'.id = pl.id ∧ pl'.storage = pl.storage ∧ pl'.internal = pl.internal ∧
      (∀ n, n ≠ j → L'.pools[n]? = L.pools[n]?) ∧ L'.pools.length = L.pools.length ∧
      L'.res = L.res ∧ L'.nId = L.nId ∧ L'.kern.A = L.kern.A ∧ L'.kern.D = L.kern.D ∧
      metaLeaves L'.kern pl' = metaLeaves L.kern pl ∧
      ∀ l ∈ metaLeaves L'.kern pl', L'.kern.I l = .init := by
  cases hs with
  | @ok pl sl hp _ _ hsl _ =>
    refine ⟨pl, sl, _, hp, hsl, rfl, getElem?_set_eq' hp, getElem?_set_eq' hsl,
      fun i hi => getElem?_set_ne' hi, rfl, rfl, rfl, fun n hn => getElem?_set_ne' hn,
      List.length_set .., rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, fun l hl => ?_⟩
    have hl' : l ∈ metaLeaves L.kern pl := hl
    show (write3Eff L.kern (metaLeaves L.kern pl)).I l = .init; simp [write3Eff, hl']

/-- HandlePool v0.5, HP5-1 as amended by arbitration Q3 (decision of 2026-11-06): on every
library-reachable state, under `DDSound` (§80) and `StaticsOK` (§47), the metadata leaves written
by an accepted `freeSlot` are disjoint from the leaves of the freed slot, whose states the write
keeps (HP5-1: no leaf of the entry is `Init`). A shared leaf would be covered by `internal`
(§76.3: `footprint(internal) = footprint(storage)`), while the authority on which `MetaRight`
rests has effective `Modify` on it; by I1 (§50), either that authority is `internal`, impossible
along the holder chain of §43 since `internal` is held by the pool value, or `internal` has no
effective mode there, so an active strict descendant of `internal` of own mode `Modify` covers the
leaf (§43, case 3), which HP5-1' excludes. -/
theorem freeSlot_meta_disjoint {k : K} {statics : Statics} (hdd : DDSound k)
    (hst : StaticsOK statics) {L L' : PState} (hr : PReach k statics L) {j : Nat} {h : Handle}
    (hs : FreeSlotStep j h L (.ok L')) :
    ∃ pl sl, L.pools[j]? = some pl ∧ pl.slots[h.slot]? = some sl ∧
      (∀ l ∈ metaLeaves L.kern pl, l ∉ footprint L.kern.P sl.place) ∧
      ∀ l ∈ footprint L.kern.P sl.place, L'.kern.I l = L.kern.I l := by
  cases hs with
  | @ok pl sl hp _ hR hsl hc =>
    have hk := kernel_guarantee hdd hst L hr
    have hi1 : I1 L.kern := hk.2.1.1.1
    obtain ⟨v, a, hv, hml, ⟨-, hex, hall⟩, -⟩ := meta_write_of_kinv hk hR
    have hdis : ∀ l ∈ metaLeaves L.kern pl, l ∉ footprint L.kern.P sl.place := by
      intro l hl hlq
      rw [hml] at hl
      have hok := (pReach_poolWF hr).pools _ (List.mem_map_of_mem (List.mem_of_getElem? hp))
      have hin := hok.slotIn sl.place (List.mem_map_of_mem (List.mem_of_getElem? hsl)) l hlq
      obtain ⟨y, hy, ya⟩ := hR.1
      have hly : l ∈ y.footprint := by
        have := (hok.fpEq l).2 hin; simpa [Pool.shape, S3.afp, hy] using this
      have haM : effective L.kern a l = some .modify := Arena.allows_modify_iff.1 (hall l hl)
      by_cases hai : a = pl.internal
      · subst hai
        have hhold : y.holder = .place v := by
          simp only [Arena.arenaValue, Pool.entry, hy] at hv
          revert hv; cases y.holder <;> simp
        have key : ∀ x m, L.kern.ExercisableAt x m → m = .modify → x = pl.internal → False := by
          intro x m hx
          induction hx with
          | base hy' _ _ hf =>
            intro _ e; subst e; rw [hy] at hy'; cases hy'; rw [hhold] at hf; cases hf
          | @held x' p b _ y' hy' _ _ hp' _ hcb ih =>
            intro em e; subst e em; rw [hy] at hy'; cases hy'; rw [hhold] at hp'; cases hp'
            refine ih rfl (Decidable.byContradiction fun hb => ?_)
            have := effective_exclusive hi1 (Ne.symm hb) haM
            have hc' := hcb l hl
            rw [this] at hc'; exact hc'
        exact key _ _ hex rfl rfl
      · have hnone := effective_exclusive hi1 hai haM
        rw [effective_eq hy ya hly] at hnone
        have hmod : Mode.modify ∈ descModes L.kern pl.internal l := by
          unfold effOf at hnone
          split at hnone
          · cases hnone
          · split at hnone
            · assumption
            · cases hnone
        obtain ⟨c, z, hz, za, hlz, hanc, -⟩ := mem_descModes.1 hmod
        exact hc.noDesc c (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hz)) ⟨z, hz, za⟩ hanc l
          (by simp [S3.afp, hz, hlz]) hlq
    refine ⟨pl, sl, hp, hsl, hdis, fun l hl => ?_⟩
    have hn : l ∉ metaLeaves L.kern pl := fun h => hdis l h hl
    show (write3Eff L.kern (metaLeaves L.kern pl)).I l = L.kern.I l
    simp [write3Eff, hn]

theorem chain_congr {org org' : Nat → Option Nat} {i : Nat} (h : ∀ j ≤ i, org j = org' j) :
    chain org i = chain org' i := chainF_congr i i h

/-- Two elements without link of one chain are equal (§40 root places, §49.5 root
authorities). -/
theorem chainF_root {org : Nat → Option Nat} : ∀ k i r r', r ∈ chainF org k i → org r = none →
    r' ∈ chainF org k i → org r' = none → r = r'
  | 0, _, _, _, h, _, _, _ => by simp [chainF] at h
  | k + 1, i, r, r', h, hr, h', hr' => by
    simp only [chainF] at h h'; split at h
    · rename_i o ho; simp only [ho] at h'
      split at h
      · rename_i hlt; simp only [hlt, ↓reduceIte] at h'
        rcases List.mem_cons.1 h with rfl | h <;> rcases List.mem_cons.1 h' with rfl | h'
        · rfl
        · rw [chainF_none hr] at h'; simp at h'
        · rw [chainF_none hr'] at h; simp at h
        · exact chainF_root k _ r r' h hr h' hr'
      · simp at h
    · simp at h

/-- A chain contains the chain of each of its elements, for links to smaller indices (§40, §42,
§49). -/
theorem chain_trans {org : Nat → Option Nat} (hlt : ∀ i o, org i = some o → o < i) :
    ∀ n i, i < n → ∀ r, r ∈ chain org i → ∀ o ∈ chain org r, o ∈ chain org i
  | 0, _, h, _, _, _, _ => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | n + 1, i, hi, r, hr, o, ho => by
    cases hp : org i with
    | none => rw [chain_none hp] at hr; simp at hr
    | some p =>
      have hpi := hlt i p hp
      rw [chain_cons hp hpi] at hr ⊢
      rcases List.mem_cons.1 hr with rfl | hr
      · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ ho
      · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (chain_trans hlt n p (by omega) r hr o ho)

/-- An element of a chain is the link of the start or belongs to the chain of that link (§40,
§42). -/
theorem mem_chain {org : Nat → Option Nat} {i x : Nat} (h : x ∈ chain org i) :
    ∃ o, org i = some o ∧ o < i ∧ (x = o ∨ x ∈ chain org o) := by
  cases ho : org i with
  | none => rw [chain_none ho] at h; simp at h
  | some o =>
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge o i with hlt | hge
    · rw [chain_cons ho hlt] at h; exact ⟨o, rfl, hlt, List.mem_cons.1 h⟩
    · exfalso

/-! ## Root places (§40, §49.6, §49.7) -/

/-- A place belongs to at most one root place (§40). -/
theorem rootOf_unique {P : List Place} {l r r' : Nat} (hr : RootPlace P r)
    (hr' : RootPlace P r') (h : partOf P l r) (h' : partOf P l r') : r = r' := by
  obtain ⟨-, hr⟩ := hr; obtain ⟨-, hr'⟩ := hr'
  obtain ⟨-, h | h⟩ := h <;> obtain ⟨-, h' | h'⟩ := h'
  · exact h.symm.trans h'
  · subst h; rw [chain_none hr] at h'; simp at h'
  · subst h'; rw [chain_none hr'] at h; simp at h
  · exact chainF_root _ _ _ _ h hr h' hr'

/-- Every place of a well-formed state is a part of a root place (§40, §49.2). -/
theorem exists_rootPlace {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) : ∀ n q, q < n → q < s.P.length →
    ∃ r, RootPlace s.P r ∧ partOf s.P q r
  | 0, _, h, _ => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | n + 1, q, hqn, hq => by
    cases hp : parentOf s.P q with
    | none => exact ⟨q, ⟨hq, hp⟩, hq, .inl rfl⟩
    | some o =>
      obtain ⟨hlt, hol⟩ := hw.parent_lt hp
      obtain ⟨r, hr, -, hor⟩ := exists_rootPlace hw n o (by omega) hol
      refine ⟨r, hr, hq, .inr ?_⟩
      rw [chain_cons hp hlt]
      rcases hor with rfl | hor
      · exact List.mem_cons_self ..
      · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hor

/-- The footprint of a part is within the footprint of the whole (§40, §49.2). -/
theorem footprint_sub {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) {q r : Nat} (h : partOf s.P q r) {l : Nat}
    (hl : l ∈ footprint s.P q) : l ∈ footprint s.P r := by
  obtain ⟨hlP, hleaf, -, hlq⟩ := mem_footprint.1 hl
  refine mem_footprint.2 ⟨hlP, hleaf, hlP, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨-, hqr⟩ := h
  rcases hlq with rfl | hlq
  · exact hqr
  · rcases hqr with rfl | hqr
    · exact .inr hlq
    · exact .inr (chain_trans (fun i o h => (hw.parent_lt h).1) (l + 1) l (Nat.lt_succ_self l) q
        hlq r hqr)

/-- A decidable property failing somewhere below `n` has a witness below `n` (§40, search for a
leaf). -/
theorem exists_lt_not_of_not_forall {p : Nat → Prop} [DecidablePred p] :
    ∀ n, ¬ (∀ r < n, p r) → ∃ r < n, ¬ p r
      z.holder = .frame f ∧ f ∈ s.F ∧ (a₀ :: c).Nodup ∧ (a₀ :: c).getLast? = some x ∧
      Linked (CoversHolder s) (a₀ :: c)

/-! ## Initial state (§47) -/

/-- Declared static storage (§47): each element is (parent, owning static, kind) with its
initial state, `true` for `Init` and `false` for `Uninit` (read on leaves only). -/
abbrev Statics := List ((Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat) × Bool)

/-- Well-formed statics declaration (§47: the ownership graph of statics is acyclic; §49, last
paragraph: the ordering of identifiers represents this well-foundedness, and that of structural
parents): parents and owning statics are earlier statics, and a part has its parent's owning
static (§49.2). -/
def StaticsOK (statics : Statics) : Prop := ShapeOK 0 (statics.map (·.1))

/-- Decidability of `StaticsOK` (§47). -/
instance (statics : Statics) : Decidable (StaticsOK statics) := by
  unfold StaticsOK; infer_instance

/-- `S3.init statics` (§47): base frame 0 and the declared statics, owned by frame 0 or by
another static; one root `Modify` authority with no origin per root static, held by its owner;
leaves `Init` or `Uninit` as declared; no anchor, no derived authority, nothing dead, no
dynamic pinning obligation. -/
def S3.init (statics : Statics) : S3 :=
  { F := [0]
    nF := 1
    P := shapeP [] (.frame 0) (statics.map (·.1))
    I := fun l => if ((statics[l]?).map (·.2)).getD false then .init else .uninit
    A := (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))).map fun i =>
      ⟨.modify, none, footprint (shapeP [] (.frame 0) (statics.map (·.1))) i,
        shapeOwner (statics.map (·.1)) (.frame 0) i, true⟩
    D := fun _ => []
    dead := fun _ => false
    pins := [] }

/-- `StaticPinnedBottom` (§75, §80): every static place whose leaf is designated by `K.Pinned` is
directly owned by the base frame 0. A condition on `(K, statics)`. -/
def StaticPinnedBottom (k : K) (statics : Statics) : Prop :=
  ∀ l < statics.length, k.Pinned l →
    OptP ((S3.init statics).P[l]?) (fun pl => pl.owner = .frame 0) False

/-! ## Reachability (§57) -/

/-- States reachable from `S3.init statics` under the kernel steps O1–O16 (§57). -/
inductive Reachable (k : K) (statics : Statics) : S3 → Prop where
  | init : Reachable k statics (S3.init statics)
  | step {s s' : S3} : Reachable k statics s → KStep k s s' → Reachable k statics s'

/-! ## Non-vacuity examples (§47, §60–§75)

Each operation has an accepting state, decided by `decide` on concrete states built from
/-! ## Root places and root authorities (§40, §49) -/

/-- Root place (§40): an existing place with no structural parent. -/
def RootPlace (P : List Place) (r : Nat) : Prop := r < P.length ∧ parentOf P r = none

/-- Decidability of `RootPlace` (§40). -/
instance (P : List Place) (r : Nat) : Decidable (RootPlace P r) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∧ _))

/-- `RootChain` (§49.6): the origin chain of an authority covering a leaf ends at a root
authority (no origin) whose footprint is the footprint of a root place containing that leaf. -/
def RootChain (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (a : Nat) (y : Authority) (l : Nat), s.A[a]? = some y → l ∈ y.footprint → isLeaf s.P l →
    ∃ x z r, (x = a ∨ x ∈ s.ancs a) ∧ s.A[x]? = some z ∧ z.origin = none ∧ RootPlace s.P r ∧
      partOf s.P l r ∧ ∀ l', l' ∈ z.footprint ↔ l' ∈ footprint s.P r

/-- `RootHeld` (§49.7, §40): every usable root place has an active root authority of own mode
`Modify`, with no origin, held by the owner of the place, whose footprint is the footprint of the
place. -/
def RootHeld (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ r, RootPlace s.P r → s.Usable r → ∃ (i : Nat) (z : Authority) (pr : Place),
    s.A[i]? = some z ∧ z.active = true ∧ z.origin = none ∧ z.mode = .modify ∧
    s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ z.holder = pr.owner ∧ ∀ l, l ∈ z.footprint ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P r

/-- Auxiliary converse of `RootHeld` (§40, §49.7), not a clause of `WF3`: an authority with no
origin is held by the owner of the root place of every leaf it covers. -/
def RootHeldConv (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (x : Nat) (z : Authority) (l r : Nat), s.A[x]? = some z → z.origin = none → l ∈ z.footprint →
    RootPlace s.P r → partOf s.P l r → ∃ pr, s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ z.holder = pr.owner

/-! ## `WF3` (§49) -/

/-- `WF3(s)` (§49): one field per item of §49. Index order of parents and origins represents
acyclicity (§49, last paragraph). -/
structure WF3 (s : S3) : Prop where
  /-- §49.1: the stack is nonempty and duplicate-free, every frame below `nF`. -/
  frames : s.F ≠ [] ∧ s.F.Nodup ∧ ∀ f ∈ s.F, f < s.nF
  /-- §49.2: parent links are valid and acyclic (the parent precedes the child); a part shares
  its parent's owner and death marker. -/
  places : ∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (r : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.parent = some r →
    ∃ pr : Place, s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ r < q ∧ pr.owner = pl.owner ∧ s.dead r = s.dead q
  /-- §49.3: owner frames are below `nF`; owner places exist; the ownership chain of every usable
  place is finite and reaches a live frame. -/
  owners : (∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (f : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .frame f →
      f < s.nF) ∧
    (∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (o : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .place o →
      o < s.P.length) ∧
    ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∃ f, FrameOf s q f ∧ f ∈ s.F
  /-- §49.4: footprints consist of leaves of existing places. -/
  footprints : ∀ (a : Nat) (x : Authority), s.A[a]? = some x → ∀ l ∈ x.footprint,
    l < s.P.length ∧ isLeaf s.P l
  /-- §49.5: an existing origin precedes the authority, so origin chains are acyclic and end at a
  root authority. -/
  origins : ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a → a < b
  /-- §49.6: `RootChain`. -/
  rootChain : RootChain s
  /-- §49.7: `RootHeld`. -/
  rootHeld : RootHeld s
  /-- §49.8: every active authority is held by a frame of the stack or by a usable place. -/
  holders : ∀ (a : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[a]? = some y → y.active = true →
    HolderLive s y.holder

/-- A part lies below the places it belongs to (§40, §49.2). -/
theorem partOf_le {P : List Place} {l r : Nat} (h : partOf P l r) : r ≤ l := by
  rcases h.2 with rfl | h
  · exact Nat.le_refl _
  · exact Nat.le_of_lt (chain_lt h)

/-- A usable place is not dead (§40, item 1). -/
theorem usable_dead {s : S3} {q : Nat} (h : s.Usable q) : s.dead q = false := by
  cases h <;> assumption

/-- The locals are appended to the places (§72 `ok` effect). -/
theorem enterP_len (s : S3) (ls : LocalShape) :
    (enterP s ls).length = s.P.length + ls.length := by
  simp [enterP, shapeP, toShape_length]

/-- Existing places are unchanged by `enterFrame` (§72 `ok` effect). -/
theorem enterP_lt {q : Nat} (h : q < s.P.length) : (enterP s ls)[q]? = s.P[q]? :=
  List.getElem?_append_left h

  simp only [enterP, shapeP, List.getElem?_append_right (Nat.le_add_right _ _),

    (q < s.P.length ∧ s.P[q]? = some pl) ∨ (s.P.length ≤ q ∧ ∃ i, i < ls.length ∧
      q = s.P.length + i ∧ pl = ⟨(ls.toShape[i]?).bind (·.1), .frame s.nF,

  · have hi : q - s.P.length < ls.length := by

  obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 hz
  exact ⟨z₀, hz₀, rfl⟩

/-- Reanchoring and release change neither the own mode, nor the footprint, nor the holder
(§73 `ok` effect, fourth item). -/
theorem exitG_same (s : S3) (F₀ : Frames) (a : Nat) (y : Authority) :
    (exitG s F₀ a y).mode = y.mode ∧ (exitG s F₀ a y).footprint = y.footprint ∧
    (exitG s F₀ a y).holder = y.holder := by
  unfold exitG; split
  · split <;> simp
  · simp

/-- An authority active after the exit survives (§73 `ok` effect, second item). -/
theorem exitG_active {F₀ : Frames} {a : Nat} {y : Authority} :
    (exitG s F₀ a y).active = true → Survives s F₀ a := by
  unfold exitG; split
  · intro; assumption
  · simp

/-- A surviving authority stays active (§73 `ok` effect). -/
theorem exitG_surv {F₀ : Frames} {a : Nat} {y : Authority} (hy : s.A[a]? = some y)
    (h : Survives s F₀ a) : (exitG s F₀ a y).active = true := by
  have hya : y.active = true := by unfold Survives at h; rw [hy] at h; exact h.1
  unfold exitG; simp only [h, ↓reduceIte]; split <;> simpa using hya

/-- An authority active after the exit was active before (§73 `ok` effect). -/
theorem exitG_active' {F₀ : Frames} {a : Nat} {y : Authority} (hy : s.A[a]? = some y)
    (h : (exitG s F₀ a y).active = true) : y.active = true := by
  have := exitG_active h; unfold Survives at this; rw [hy] at this; exact this.1

derived authority (§73 `ok` effect, third item). -/
theorem exitG_origin {F₀ : Frames} {a : Nat} {y : Authority} :
    (exitG s F₀ a y).origin = y.origin ∨
    (Survives s F₀ a ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧ (exitG s F₀ a y).origin = firstSurv s F₀ (s.ancs a)) := by
  unfold exitG; split
  · rename_i hs; split
    · exact .inl rfl
    · rename_i o ho; exact .inr ⟨hs, by simp [ho], rfl⟩
  · exact .inl rfl

import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Main

/-!
# Access kernel: no active authority covers a leaf of its own holder

The auxiliary invariant `NoSelfLock` (not a clause of §57 of
`specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md`): no authority satisfies `SelfLock` (§63.8). It
holds initially (§47) and every kernel step keeps it from a `WF3` state (§49): `transfer` through
§63.8, `store` through §65.3, `alloc` because its new root covers only new leaves (§71), the other
steps because they move no holder onto a covered place (§60–§75 `ok` effects). Hence it holds on
every reachable state (§57, `reachable_noSelfLock`).
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-- `NoSelfLock` (auxiliary invariant, not a clause of §57): no authority is `SelfLock` (§63.8;
kept by §63.8 and §65.3, see also §88). -/
def NoSelfLock (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ x, ¬ SelfLock s x

/-- Introduction of `NoSelfLock` (§63.8). -/
theorem noSelfLock_intro {s : S3}
    (h : ∀ x y l, s.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true → l ∈ y.footprint →
      l ∈ holderLeaves s y.holder → False) : NoSelfLock s := by
  intro x hx
  unfold SelfLock at hx
  cases hy : s.A[x]? with
  | none => rw [hy] at hx; exact hx
  | some y => rw [hy] at hx; obtain ⟨ya, l, hl, hh⟩ := hx; exact h x y l hy ya hl hh

/-- Elimination of `NoSelfLock` (§63.8). -/
theorem NoSelfLock.elim {s : S3} (h : NoSelfLock s) {x : Nat} {y : Authority} {l : Nat}
    (hy : s.A[x]? = some y) (ya : y.active = true) (hl : l ∈ y.footprint)
    (hh : l ∈ holderLeaves s y.holder) : False :=
  h x (by unfold SelfLock; rw [hy]; exact ⟨ya, l, hl, hh⟩)

/-- A frame has no leaves (§63.8). -/
theorem not_mem_holderLeaves_frame {s : S3} {f l : Nat} : l ∉ holderLeaves s (.frame f) :=
  fun h => by simp [holderLeaves] at h

/-- `NoSelfLock` depends only on the places and the authorities (§38, §63.8). -/
theorem NoSelfLock.congr {s s' : S3} (h : NoSelfLock s) (hA : s'.A = s.A) (hP : s'.P = s.P) :
    NoSelfLock s' :=
  noSelfLock_intro fun x y l hy ya hl hh => by
    rw [hA] at hy
    exact h.elim hy ya hl (by unfold holderLeaves at hh ⊢; rw [hP] at hh; exact hh)

/-- An element of an appended list comes from one of the two parts (§42: authorities added by
`split`). -/
private theorem getElem?_append_cases {α : Type} {l E : List α} {x : Nat} {y : α}
    (h : (l ++ E)[x]? = some y) : l[x]? = some y ∨ y ∈ E := by
  by_cases hx : x < l.length
  · rw [List.getElem?_append_left hx] at h; exact .inl h
  · rw [List.getElem?_append_right (by omega)] at h; exact .inr (List.mem_of_getElem? h)

/-! ## The initial state (§47) -/

/-- The initial state satisfies `NoSelfLock` for a well-formed statics declaration (`StaticsOK`,
§47): the root authority of a root static is held by frame 0 or by its owning static, an earlier
static that is not a part of it (§40, §47). -/
theorem init_noSelfLock {statics : Statics} (hst : StaticsOK statics) :
    NoSelfLock (S3.init statics) := by
  have hw : WF3 (S3.init statics) := (init_kinv hst).1.1
  have hlen : (S3.init statics).P.length = statics.length := by simp [S3.init, shapeP]
  refine noSelfLock_intro fun x y l hy ya hl hh => ?_
  simp only [S3.init, List.getElem?_map] at hy
  obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 hy
  have hmem := List.mem_of_getElem? hi
  simp only [rootIdx, List.mem_filter, List.mem_range, Option.isNone_iff_eq_none] at hmem
  obtain ⟨hil, hpn⟩ := hmem
  sorry

end Ern.MemoryModel.Access

theorem NoSelfLock.elim {s : S3} (h : NoSelfLock s) {x : Nat} {y : Authority} {l : Nat}
    (hy : s.A[x]? = some y) (ya : y.active = true) (hl : l ∈ y.footprint)
    (hh : l ∈ holderLeaves s y.holder) : False :=
  h x (by unfold SelfLock; rw [hy]; exact ⟨ya, l, hl, hh⟩)

/-- A frame has no leaves (§63.8). -/
theorem not_mem_holderLeaves_frame {s : S3} {f l : Nat} : l ∉ holderLeaves s (.frame f) :=
  fun h => by simp [holderLeaves] at h

/-- `NoSelfLock` depends only on the places and the authorities (§38, §63.8). -/
theorem NoSelfLock.congr {s s' : S3} (h : NoSelfLock s) (hA : s'.A = s.A) (hP : s'.P = s.P) :
    NoSelfLock s' :=
  noSelfLock_intro fun x y l hy ya hl hh => by
    rw [hA] at hy
    exact h.elim hy ya hl (by unfold holderLeaves at hh ⊢; rw [hP] at hh; exact hh)

/-- An element of an appended list comes from one of the two parts (§42: authorities added by
`split`). -/
private theorem getElem?_append_cases {α : Type} {l E : List α} {x : Nat} {y : α}
    (h : (l ++ E)[x]? = some y) : l[x]? = some y ∨ y ∈ E := by
  by_cases hx : x < l.length
  · rw [List.getElem?_append_left hx] at h; exact .inl h
  · rw [List.getElem?_append_right (by omega)] at h; exact .inr (List.mem_of_getElem? h)

/-! ## The initial state (§47) -/

/-- The initial state satisfies `NoSelfLock` for a well-formed statics declaration (`StaticsOK`,
§47): the root authority of a root static is held by frame 0 or by its owning static, an earlier
static that is not a part of it (§40, §47). -/
theorem init_noSelfLock {statics : Statics} (hst : StaticsOK statics) :
    NoSelfLock (S3.init statics) := by
  have hw : WF3 (S3.init statics) := (init_kinv hst).1.1
  have hlen : (S3.init statics).P.length = statics.length := by simp [S3.init, shapeP]
  refine noSelfLock_intro fun x y l hy ya hl hh => ?_
  simp only [S3.init, List.getElem?_map] at hy
  obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 hy
  have hmem := List.mem_of_getElem? hi
  simp only [rootIdx, List.mem_filter, List.mem_range, Option.isNone_iff_eq_none] at hmem
  obtain ⟨hil, hpn⟩ := hmem
  sorry

end Ern.MemoryModel.Access

1	import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Main
2	
3	/-!
4	# Access kernel: no active authority covers a leaf of its own holder
5	
6	The auxiliary invariant `NoSelfLock` (not a clause of §57 of
7	`specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md`): no authority satisfies `SelfLock` (§63.8). It
8	holds initially (§47) and every kernel step keeps it from a `WF3` state (§49): `transfer` through
9	§63.8, `store` through §65.3, `alloc` because its new root covers only new leaves (§71), the other
10	steps because they move no holder onto a covered place (§60–§75 `ok` effects). Hence it holds on
11	every reachable state (§57, `reachable_noSelfLock`).
12	-/
13	
14	namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access
15	
16	/-- `NoSelfLock` (auxiliary invariant, not a clause of §57): no authority is `SelfLock` (§63.8;
17	kept by §63.8 and §65.3, see also §88). -/
18	def NoSelfLock (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ x, ¬ SelfLock s x
19	
20	/-- Introduction of `NoSelfLock` (§63.8). -/
21	theorem noSelfLock_intro {s : S3}
22	    (h : ∀ (x : Nat) (y : Authority) (l : Nat), s.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true → l ∈ y.footprint →
23	      l ∈ holderLeaves s y.holder → False) : NoSelfLock s := by
24	  intro x hx
25	  unfold SelfLock at hx
26	  cases hy : s.A[x]? with
27	  | none => rw [hy] at hx; exact hx
28	  | some y => rw [hy] at hx; obtain ⟨ya, l, hl, hh⟩ := hx; exact h x y l hy ya hl hh
29

contract): `m2` is library-reachable, pool 0 has `AdminRight` (§36) and its value, place 0, has the
`Moved` leaf 1 (§63); the write of the leaves of the pool value (§67) that `freeSlot_meta_write`
provides is then not the identity on the kernel state. Continued by `allocSlot(0, 7)` and an
accepted `freeSlot(⟨0, 0, 0⟩)`, this is a conforming case, no longer a limit: the arrival kernel

    StaticsOK vst ∧ PReach K0 vst m2 ∧ m2.pools[0]? = some pv ∧ AdminRight m2.kern pv ∧
    Arena.arenaValue m2.kern pv.entry = some 0 ∧ m2.kern.I 1 = .moved ∧
    write3Eff m2.kern (footprint m2.kern.P 0) ≠ m2.kern ∧
    AllocSlotStep 0 7 m2 (.ok m3) ∧ FreeSlotStep 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ m3 (.ok m4) ∧ PReach K0 vst m4 ∧

    congrArg (write3Eff m3.kern) (by decide : metaLeaves m3.kern pv3 = footprint m3.kern.P 0)
  have i4 : m4.kern.I 1 = .init := by decide
  have i3 : m3.kern.I 1 = .moved := by decide
  exact ⟨by decide, h2, rfl, by decide, by decide, by decide, hne, a3, f4,
    .step (.step h2 (.allocSlot a3)) (.freeSlot f4), by decide, i3, e4,

/-! ## The initial state (§47) -/

/-- The initial state satisfies `NoSelfLock` for a well-formed statics declaration (`StaticsOK`,
§47): the root authority of a root static is held by frame 0 or by its owning static, an earlier
static that is not a part of it (§40, §47). -/
theorem init_noSelfLock {statics : Statics} (hst : StaticsOK statics) :
    NoSelfLock (S3.init statics) := by
  have hw : WF3 (S3.init statics) := (init_kinv hst).1.1
  have hlen : (S3.init statics).P.length = statics.length := by simp [S3.init, shapeP]
  refine noSelfLock_intro fun x y l hy ya hl hh => ?_
  simp only [S3.init, List.getElem?_map] at hy
  obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 hy
  have hmem := List.mem_of_getElem? hi
  simp only [rootIdx, List.mem_filter, List.mem_range, Option.isNone_iff_eq_none] at hmem
  obtain ⟨hil, hpn⟩ := hmem
  have hroot : RootPlace (S3.init statics).P i := by
    refine ⟨by rw [hlen]; simpa using hil, ?_⟩
    simp only [parentOf, S3.init, shapeP, List.nil_append, List.getElem?_map,
      List.getElem?_range hil, Option.map_some, Option.bind_some]
    simpa using hpn
  simp only [shapeOwner] at hh
  split at hh
  · rename_i o ho
    have hoi : o < i := by
      have := (hst i (List.mem_range.2 hil)).2
      rw [ho] at this; have := this.2; omega
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hor⟩ := exists_rootPlace hw (o + 1) o (Nat.lt_succ_self o)
      (by rw [hlen]; simp at hil; omega)
    have hlr := footprint_sub hw hor hh
    obtain rfl := rootOf_unique hr hroot (mem_footprint.1 hlr).2.2 (mem_footprint.1 hl).2.2
    have := Frames.partOf_le hor; omega
  · exact not_mem_holderLeaves_frame hh

/-! ## Preservation by every step (§60–§75) -/

/-- Every kernel step keeps `NoSelfLock` from a `WF3` state (§49.8: holders of active authorities
are live): `derive`, `split` and `enterFrame` add frame-held authorities (§60, §61, §72);
`release`, `exitFrame`, `endUse`, `free` only deactivate, reanchor or keep authorities (§62, §73,
§69, §70); `transfer` is guarded by §63.8 and keeps footprints (§63); `store` by §65.3; the new
root of `alloc` covers only new leaves, its owner only former ones (§71); the remaining steps
change neither places nor authorities (§64, §66–§68, §74, §75). -/
theorem kstep_preserves_noSelfLock {k : K} {s s' : S3} (hw : WF3 s) (hns : NoSelfLock s)
    (h : KStep k s s') : NoSelfLock s' := by
  cases h with
  | derive h =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h

- `def NoSelfLock (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ x, ¬ SelfLock s x`. Docstring: auxiliary invariant, not a clause of §57; cites §63.8, kept by §63.8 and §65.3, see also §88.

HandlePool.lean:
- `theorem pool_entries_meta_disjoint {k} {statics} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics) {L : PState} (hr : PReach k statics L) {pl : Pool} (hpl : pl ∈ L.pools) (ha : L.kern.Active pl.internal) {sl : Slot} (hsl : sl ∈ pl.slots) : ∀ l ∈ footprint L.kern.P sl.place, l ∉ metaLeaves L.kern pl`. Docstring cites HandlePool v0.5 D.1, HP5-1 (Q3 decision of 2026-11-06), §46 analogue, §76.3, §63.8, §65.3, and says no ownership is assumed (§46).
- Corollary `theorem freeSlot_keeps_entries (hdd) (hst) (hr : PReach k statics L) (hs : FreeSlotStep j h L (.ok L')) : ∃ pl, L.pools[j]? = some pl ∧ ∀ sl ∈ pl.slots, ∀ l ∈ footprint L.kern.P sl.place, L'.kern.I l = L.kern.I l`.

## Deviations
1. **`hdd` in `reachable_noSelfLock`.** It is needed. In the enter and alloc cases, an old active authority held by place `q` must have `q < P.length`. Otherwise new places at index ≥ |P| would give `q` new leaves, so `NoSelfLock` alone is not inductive. That bound comes from `WF3.holders`, and the only route to `WF3` on reachable states is `reachable_kinv`, which takes `DDSound`. Dropping `hdd` would mean a separate 16-case induction for that holder bound.
2. **"Held by a place v" is not a hypothesis** of `pool_entries_meta_disjoint`. If `internal` is held by a frame, `metaLeaves` is `[]` and the result is trivial, so the statement is slightly stronger than asked. I kept "internal is active", which the argument needs.

- **Init:** the root of static `i` is held by frame 0 or by its owning static `o` with `o < i`. A shared leaf would put `o`'s root equal to `i`, so `o` would be a part of `i`, which forces `i ≤ o`; contradiction. - **transfer:** footprints are unchanged (`transfer_footprint`), and the moved authorities are exactly the ones `NoLocalSelfLock` (§63.8) covers.
- **store:** the first half of `StorePre.noCover` (§65.3) is used directly.
- **alloc:** the new root covers only leaves ≥ |P| (`Alloc.fp_new_ge`), and its owner is usable, so it has only former leaves (`Alloc.footprint_old`).

I evaluated these with a scratch `#eval` in `/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-guygouri--claude-spares-spare-IF4EaH/b714fc3e-3648-484e-9e36-92ef9596c59b/scratchpad/own.lean`, which is not in the repo.

| Witness states | Storage | Storage owner | Pool value | Storage owned by the pool value? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `w3`, `w4`, `x1`–`x7` | 0 | frame 0 | place 3 | no |
| `c3`, `c4`, `c8`, `c9`, `c10` | 0 | frame 0 | place 3 | no |
| `m1`–`m4` | 3 | place 0 | place 0 | yes, directly |

- `OwnedIn` is false in the `w`/`x`/`c` rows and true in the `m` rows.
- The storage is never a part of the pool value.
- In every evaluated state the pool is live, and every slot's leaves are disjoint from `metaLeaves` (`[3]` in the first two groups, `[1, 2]` in the `m` group).

So the Q3 point holds both ways: with owned storage (`m`) and without (`w`/`x`/`c`). The disjointness never relies on ownership; it comes from `internal` covering exactly the storage leaves and never covering a leaf of its own holder.
